stale-answer-ttl. [RT #44790]

4699.

Multiple cookie-secret clauses can now be specified.
The first one specified is used to generate new

server cookies.

[RT #45672]

4698.

Add --with-python-install-dir configure option to allow
specifying a nonstandard installation directory for
Python modules. [RT #45407]

4697.

Restore workaround for Microsoft Windows TSIG hash
computation bug. [RT #45854]

4696.

Enable filter-aaaa support by default on Windows
builds. [RT #45883]

4695.

cookie-secrets were not being properly checked by
named-checkconf. [RT #45886]

4694.

dnssec-keygen no longer uses RSASHA1 by default;
the signing algorithm must be specified on
the command line with the "-a" option. Signing
scripts that rely on the existing default behavior
will break; use "dnssec-keygen -a RSASHA1" to
repair them. (The goal of this change is to make
it easier to find scripts using RSASHA1 so they
can be changed in the event of that algorithm
being deprecated in the future.) [RT #44755]

4693.

Synthesis of responses from DNSSEC-verified records.
Stage 1 covers NXDOMAIN synthesis from NSEC records.
This is controlled by synth-from-dnssec and is enabled
by default. [RT #40138]

4692.

Fix build failures with libressl introduced in 4676.
[RT #45879]

4691.

Add -4/-6 command line options to nsupdate and rndc.
[RT #45632]

4690.

Command line options -4/-6 were handled inconsistently
between tools. [RT #45632]

4689.

Turn on minimal responses for CDNSKEY and CDS in
addition to DNSKEY and DS. Thanks to Tony Finch.
[RT #45690]

4688.

Check and display EDNS KEY TAG options (RFC 8145) in
messages. [RT #44804]

4687.

Refactor tracklines code. [RT #45126]

4686.

dnssec-settime -p could print a bogus warning about
key deletion scheduled before its inactivation when a
key had an inactivation date set but no deletion date
set. [RT #45807]

4685.

dnssec-settime incorrectly calculated publication and
activation dates for a successor key. [RT #45806]

4684.

delv could send bogus DNS queries when an explicit
server address was specified on the command line along
with -4/-6. [RT #45804]

4683.

Prevent nsupdate from immediately exiting on invalid
user input in interactive mode. [RT #28194]

4682.

Don't report errors on records below a DNAME.
[RT #44880]

4681.

Log messages from the validator now include the
associated view unless the view is "_default/IN"
or "_dnsclient/IN". [RT #45770]

4680.

Fix failing over to another master server address when
nsupdate is used with GSS-API. [RT #45380]

4679.

Suggest using -o when dnssec-verify finds a SOA record
not at top of zone and -o is not used. [RT #45519]

4678.

geoip-use-ecs has the wrong type when geoip support
is disabled at configure time. [RT #45763]

4677.

Split up the main function in dig to better support
the iOS app version. [RT #45508]

4676.

Allow BIND to be built using OpenSSL 1.0.X with
deprecated functions removed. [RT #45706]

4675.

Don't use C++ keyword class. [RT #45726]

4674.

"dig +sigchase", and related options "+topdown" and
"+trusted-keys", have been removed. Use "delv" for
queries with DNSSEC validation. [RT #42793]

4673.

Silence GCC 7 warnings. [RT #45592]

4672.

4671.

Fix a race condition that could cause the
resolver to crash with assertion failure when
chasing DS in specific conditions with a very
short RTT to the upstream nameserver. [RT #45168]

4670.

Ensure that a request MAC is never sent back
in an XFR response unless the signature was
verified. [RT #45494]

4669.

Iterative query logic in resolver.c has been
refactored into smaller functions and commented,
for improved readability, maintainability and
testability. [RT #45362]

4668.

Use localtime_r and gmtime_r for thread safety.
[RT #45664]

4667.

Refactor RDATA unit tests. [RT #45610]

4666.

dnssec-keymgr: Domain names beginning with digits (0-9)
could cause a parser error when reading the policy
file. This now works correctly so long as the domain
name is quoted. [RT #45641]

4665.

Added support for ED25519 and ED448 DNSSEC signing
algorithms (RFC 8080). (Note: these algorithms
depend on code currently in the development branch
of OpenSSL which has not yet been released.)
[RT #44696]

4664.

Add a "glue-cache" option to enable or disable the
glue cache. The default is "yes". [RT #45125]

4663.

Clarify error message printed by dnssec-dsfromkey.
[RT #21731]

4662.

Improve cache memory cleanup of zero TTL records
by putting them at the tail of LRU header lists.
[RT #45274]

4661.

A race condition could occur if a zone was reloaded
while resigning, triggering a crash in
rbtdb.c:closeversion(). [RT #45276]

4660.

Remove spurious "peer" from Windows socket log
messages. [RT #45617]

4659.

Remove spurious log message about lmdb-mapsize
not being supported when parsing builtin
configuration file. [RT #45618]

4658.

Clean up build directory created by "setup.py install"
immediately. [RT #45628]

4657.

rrchecker system test result could be improperly
determined. [RT #45602]

4656.

Apply "port" and "dscp" values specified in catalog
zone's "default-masters" option to the generated
configuration of its member zones. [RT #45545]

4655.

Lack of seccomp could be falsely reported. [RT #45599]

4654.

Don't use C++ keywords delete, new and namespace.
[RT #45538]

4653.

Reorder includes to move @DST_OPENSSL_INC@ and
@ISC_OPENSSL_INC@ after shipped include directories.
[RT #45581]

4652.

Nsupdate could attempt to use a zeroed address on
server timeout. [RT #45417]

4651.

Silence coverity warnings in tsig_test.c. [RT #45528]

4650.

4649.

The wrong zone was logged when a catalog zone is added.
[RT #45520]

4648.

"rndc reconfig" on a slave no longer causes all member
zones of configured catalog zones to be removed from
configuration. [RT #45310]

4647.

Change 4643 broke verification of TSIG signed TCP
message sequences where not all the messages contain
TSIG records. These may be used in AXFR and IXFR
responses. [RT #45509]

4646.

4645.

4644.

4643.

An error in TSIG handling could permit unauthorized
zone transfers or zone updates. (CVE-2017-3142)
(CVE-2017-3143) [RT #45383]

4642.

Add more logging of RFC 5011 events affecting the
status of managed keys: newly observed keys,
deletion of revoked keys, etc. [RT #45354]

4641.

Parallel builds (make -j) could fail with --with-atf /
--enable-developer. [RT #45373]

4640.

If query_findversion failed in query_getdb due to
memory failure the error status was incorrectly
discarded. [RT #45331]

4639.

Fix a regression in --with-tuning reporting introduced
by change 4488. [RT #45396]

Fix PKCS#11 RSA parsing when MD5 is disabled.
[RT #45300]

4638.

Reloading or reconfiguring named could fail on
some platforms when LMDB was in use. [RT #45203]

4637.

"nsec3hash -r" option ("rdata order") takes arguments
in the same order as they appear in NSEC3 or
NSEC3PARAM records, so that NSEC3 parameters can
be cut and pasted from an existing record. Thanks
to Tony Finch for the contribution. [RT #45183]

4636.

Normalize rpz policy zone names when checking for
existence. [RT #45358]

4635.

Fix RPZ NSDNAME logging that was logging
failures as NSIP. [RT #45052]

4634.

check5011.pl needs to handle optional space before
semi-colon in +multi-line output. [RT #45352]

4633.

Updated AAAA (2001:500:200::b) for B.ROOT-SERVERS.NET.

4632.

The BIND installer on Windows used an unquoted
service path, which can enable privilege escalation.
(CVE-2017-3141) [RT #45229]

4631.

Some RPZ configurations could go into an infinite
query loop when encountering responses with TTL=0.
(CVE-2017-3140) [RT #45181]

4630.

"dyndb" is dependent on dlopen existing / being
enabled. [RT #45291]

4629.

dns_client_startupdate could not be called with a
running client. [RT #45277]

4628.

Fixed a potential reference leak in query_getdb().
[RT #45247]

4627.

4626.

Added more tests for handling of different record
ordering in CNAME and DNAME responses. [QA #430]

4625.

Running "rndc addzone" and "rndc delzone" at close
to the same time could trigger a deadlock if using
LMDB. [RT #45209]

4624.

4623.

Use --with-protobuf-c and --with-libfstrm to find
protoc-c and fstrm_capture. [RT #45187]

4622.

Remove unnecessary escaping of semicolon in CAA and
URI records. [RT #45216]

4621.

Force alignment of oid arrays to silence loader
warnings. [RT #45131]

4620.

Handle EPFNOSUPPORT being returned when probing
to see if a socket type is supported. [RT #45214]

4619.

Call isc_mem_put instead of isc_mem_free in
bin/named/server.c:setup_newzones. [RT #45202]

4618.

Check isc_mem_strdup results in dns_view_setnewzones.
Add logging for lmdb call failures. [RT #45204]

4617.

Update rndc system test to be more delay tolerant.
[RT #45177]

4616.

When using LMDB, zones deleted using "rndc delzone"
were not correctly removed from the new-zone
database. [RT #45185]

4615.

AD could be set on truncated answer with no records
present in the answer and authority sections.
[RT #45140]

4614.

Fixed an error in the sockaddr unit test. [RT #45146]

4613.

By default, the maximum size of a zone journal file
is now twice the size of the zone's contents (there
is little benefit to a journal larger than this).
This can be overridden by setting "max-journal-size"
to "unlimited" or to an explicit value up to 2G.
Thanks to Tony Finch. [RT #38324]

4612.

Silence 'may be use uninitalised' warning and simplify
the code in lwres/getaddinfo:process_answer.
[RT #45158]

4611.

The default LMDB mapsize was too low and caused
errors after few thousand zones were added using
rndc addzone. A new config option "lmdb-mapsize"
has been introduced to configure the LMDB
mapsize depending on operational needs.
[RT #44954]

4610.

The "new-zones-directory" option specifies the
location of NZF or NZD files for storing
configuration of zones added by "rndc addzone".
Thanks to Petr Menšík. [RT #44853]

4609.

Rearrange makefiles to enable parallel execution

(i.e. "make -j"). [RT #45078]
4608.

DiG now warns about .local queries which are reserved
for Multicast DNS. [RT #44783]

4607.

The memory context's malloced and maxmalloced counters
were being updated without the appropriate lock being
held. [RT #44869]

4606.

Stop using experimental "Experimental keys on scalar"
feature of perl as it has been removed. [RT #45012]

4605.

Improve performance for delegation heavy answers
and also general query performance. Removes the
acache feature that didn't significantly improve
performance. Adds a glue cache. Removes
additional-from-cache and additional-from-auth
features. Enables minimal-responses by
default. Improves performance of compression
code, owner case restoration, hash function,
etc. Uses inline buffer implementation by
default. Many other performance changes and fixes.
[RT #44029]

4604.

Don't use ERR_load_crypto_strings() when building
with OpenSSL 1.1.0. [RT #45117]

4603.

Automatically generate named.conf(5) man page
from doc/misc/options. Thanks to Tony Finch.
[RT #43525]

4602.

Threads are now set to human-readable
names to assist debugging, when supported by
the OS. [RT #43234]

4601.

Reject incorrect RSA key lengths during key
generation and and sign/verify context
creation. [RT #45043]

4600.

Adjust RPZ trigger counts only when the entry
being deleted exists. [RT #43386]

4599.

Fix inconsistencies in inline signing time
comparison that were introduced with the
introduction of rdatasetheader->resign_lsb.
[RT #42112]

4598.

Update fuzzing code to (1) reply to a DNSKEY
query from named with appropriate DNSKEY used in
fuzzing; (2) patch the QTYPE correctly in
resolver fuzzing; (3) comment things so the rest
of us are able to understand how fuzzing is

implemented in named; (4) Coding style changes,
cleanup, etc. [RT #44787]
4597.

The validator now ignores SHA-1 DS digest type
when a DS record with SHA-384 digest type is
present and is a supported digest type.
[RT #45017]

4596.

Validate glue before adding it to the additional
section. This also fixes incorrect TTL capping
when the RRSIG expired earlier than the TTL.
[RT #45062]

4595.

dnssec-keygen will no longer generate RSA keys
less than 1024 bits in length. dnssec-keymgr
was similarly updated. [RT #36895]

4594.

"dnstap-read -x" prints a hex dump of the wire
format of each logged DNS message. [RT #44816]

4593.

Update README using markdown, remove outdated FAQ
file in favor of the knowledge base.

4592.

A race condition on shutdown could trigger an
assertion failure in dispatch.c. [RT #43822]

4591.

Addressed some python 3 compatibility issues.
Thanks to Ville Skytta. [RT #44955] [RT #44956]

4590.

Support for PTHREAD_MUTEX_ADAPTIVE_NP was not being
properly detected. [RT #44871]

4589.

"configure -q" is now silent. [RT #44829]

4588.

nsupdate could send queries for TKEY to the wrong
server when using GSSAPI. Thanks to Tomas Hozza.
[RT #39893]

4587.

named-checkzone failed to handle occulted data below
DNAMEs correctly. [RT #44877]

4586.

dig, host and nslookup now use TCP for ANY queries.
[RT #44687]

4585.

win32: Set CompileAS value. [RT #42474]

4584.

A number of memory usage statistics were not properly
reported when they exceeded 4G. [RT #44750]

4583.

"host -A" returns most records for a name but
omits RRSIG, NSEC and NSEC3. (Thanks to Tony Finch.)
[RT #43032]

4582.

'rndc ""' could trigger a assertion failure in named.
(CVE-2017-3138) [RT #44924]

4581.

Linux: Add getpid and getrandom to the list of system
calls named uses for seccomp. [RT #44883]

4580.

4578 introduced a regression when handling CNAME to
referral below the current domain. [RT #44850]

4579.

Logging channels and dnstap output files can now
be configured with a "suffix" option, set to
either "increment" or "timestamp", indicating
whether to use incrementing numbers or timestamps
as the file suffix when rolling over a log file.
[RT #42838]

4578.

Some chaining (CNAME or DNAME) responses to upstream
queries could trigger assertion failures.
(CVE-2017-3137) [RT #44734]

4577.

Make qtype of resolver fuzzing packet configurable
via command line. [RT #43540]

4576.

The RPZ implementation has been substantially
refactored for improved performance and reliability.
[RT #43449]

4575.

DNS64 with "break-dnssec yes;" can result in an
assertion failure. (CVE-2017-3136) [RT #44653]

4574.

Dig leaked memory with multiple +subnet options.
[RT #44683]

4573.

Query logic has been substantially refactored (e.g.
query_find function has been split into smaller
functions) for improved readability, maintainability
and testability. [RT #43929]

4572.

The "dnstap-output" option can now take "size" and
"versions" parameters to indicate the maximum size
a dnstap log file can grow before rolling to a new
file, and how many old files to retain. [RT #44502]

4571.

Out-of-tree builds of backtrace_test failed.

4570.

named did not correctly fall back to the built-in
initializing keys if the bind.keys file was present
but empty. [RT #44531]

4569.

Store both local and remote addresses in dnstap
logging, and modify dnstap-read output format to

print them. [RT #43595]
4568.

Added a --with-bind option to the dnsperf configure
script to specify BIND prefix path.

4567.

Call getprotobyname and getservbyname prior to calling
chroot so that shared libraries get loaded. [RT #44537]

4566.

Query logging now includes the ECS option if one
was included in the query. [RT #44476]

4565.

The inline macro versions of isc_buffer_put*()
did not implement automatic buffer reallocation.
[RT #44216]

4564.

Update the built in managed keys to include the
upcoming root KSK. [RT #44579]

4563.

Modified zones would occasionally fail to reload.
[RT #39424]

4562.

Add additional memory statistics currently malloced
and maxmalloced per memory context. [RT #43593]

4561.

Silence a warning in strict C99 compilers. [RT #44414]

4560.

mdig: add -m option to enable memory debugging rather
than having it on all the time. [RT #44509]

4559.

openssl_link.c didn't compile if ISC_MEM_TRACKLINES
was turned off. [RT #44509]

4558.

Synthesised CNAME before matching DNAME was still
being cached when it should not have been. [RT #44318]

4557.

Combining dns64 and rpz can result in dereferencing
a NULL pointer (read). (CVE-2017-3135) [RT#44434]

4556.

Sending an EDNS Padding option using "dig
+ednsopt" could cause a crash in dig. [RT #44462]

4555.

dig +ednsopt: EDNS options can now be specified by
name in addition to numeric value. [RT #44461]

4554.

Remove double unlock in dns_dispatchmgr_setudp.
[RT #44336]

4553.

Named could deadlock there were multiple changes to
NSEC/NSEC3 parameters for a zone being processed at
the same time. [RT #42770]

4552.

Named could trigger a assertion when sending notify

messages. [RT #44019]
4551.

Add system tests for integrity checks of MX and
SRV records. [RT #43953]

4550.

Increased the number of available master file
output style flags from 32 to 64. [RT #44043]

4549.

Added support for the EDNS TCP Keepalive option
(RFC 7828). [RT #42126]

4548.

Added support for the EDNS Padding option (RFC 7830).
[RT #42094]

4547.

Add support for --enable-native-pkcs11 on the AEP
Keyper HSM. [RT #42463]

4546.

Extend the use of const declarations. [RT #43379]

4545.

Expand YAML output from dnstap-read to include
a detailed breakdown of the DNS message contents.
[RT #43642]

4544.

Add message/payload size to dnstap-read YAML output.
[RT #43622]

4543.

dns_client_startupdate now delays sending the update
request until isc_app_ctxrun has been called.
[RT #43976]

4542.

Allow rndc to manipulate redirect zones with using
-redirect as the zone name (use "-redirect." to
manipulate a zone named "-redirect"). [RT #43971]

4541.

rndc addzone should properly reject non master/slave
zones. [RT #43665]

4540.

Correctly handle ecs entries in dns_acl_isinsecure.
[RT #43601]

4539.

Referencing a nonexistent zone with RPZ could lead
to a assertion failure when configuring. [RT #43787]

4538.

Call dns_client_startresolve from client->task.
[RT #43896]

4537.

Handle timeouts better in dig/host/nslookup. [RT #43576]

4536.

ISC_SOCKEVENTATTR_USEMINMTU was not being cleared
when reusing the event structure. [RT #43885]

4535.

Address race condition in setting / testing of

DNS_REQUEST_F_SENDING. [RT #43889]
4534.

Only set RD, RA and CD in QUERY responses. [RT #43879]

4533.

dns_client_update should terminate on prerequisite
failures (NXDOMAIN, YXDOMAIN, NXRRSET, YXRRSET)
and also on BADZONE. [RT #43865]

4532.

Make gen-data-queryperf.py python 3 compatible.
[RT #43836]

4531.

'is_zone' was not being properly updated by redirect2
and subsequently preserved leading to an assertion
failure. (CVE-2016-9778) [RT #43837]

4530.

Change 4489 broke the handling of CNAME -> DNAME
in responses resulting in SERVFAIL being returned.
[RT #43779]

4529.

Silence noisy log warning when DSCP probe fails
due to firewall rules. [RT #43847]

4528.

Only set the flag bits for the i/o we are waiting
for on EPOLLERR or EPOLLHUP. [RT #43617]

4527.

Support DocBook XSL Stylesheets v1.79.1. [RT #43831]

4526.

Corrected errors and improved formatting of
grammar definitions in the ARM. [RT #43739]

4525.

Fixed outdated documentation on managed-keys.
[RT #43810]

4524.

The net zero test was broken causing IPv4 servers
with addresses ending in .0 to be rejected. [RT #43776]

4523.

Expand config doc for <querysource4> and
<querysource6>. [RT #43768]

4522.

Handle big gaps in log file version numbers better.
[RT #38688]

4521.

Log it as an error if an entropy source is not
found and there is no fallback available. [RT #43659]

4520.

Alphabetize more of the grammar when printing it
out. Fix unbalanced indenting. [RT #43755]

4519.

win32: handle ERROR_MORE_DATA. [RT #43534]

4518.

The "print-time" option in the logging configuration
can now take arguments "local", "iso8601" or

"iso8601-utc" to indicate the format in which the
date and time should be logged. For backward
compatibility, "yes" is a synonym for "local".
[RT #42585]
4517.

Named could mishandle authority sections that were
missing RRSIGs triggering an assertion failure.
(CVE-2016-9444) [RT # 43632]

4516.

isc_socketmgr_renderjson was missing from the
windows build. [RT #43602]

4515.

FreeBSD: Find readline headers when they are in
edit/readline/ instead of readline/. [RT #43658]

4514.

NetBSD: strip -WL, from ld command line. [RT #43204]

4513.

Minimum Python versions are now 2.7 and 3.2.
[RT #43566]

4512.

win32: @GEOIP_INC@ missing from delv.vcxproj.in.
[RT #43556]

4511.

win32: mdig.exe-BNFT was missing Configure. [RT #43554]

4510.

Named mishandled some responses where covering RRSIG
records are returned without the requested data

[RT #43548]

4509.

Make the rrl system test more reliable on slower
machines by using mdig instead of dig. [RT #43280]

4508.

Named incorrectly tried to cache TKEY records which
could trigger a assertion failure when there was
a class mismatch. (CVE-2016-9131) [RT #43522]

4507.

Named could incorrectly log 'allows updates by IP
address, which is insecure' [RT #43432]

4506.

'named-checkconf -l' will now list the zones found in
named.conf. [RT #43154]

4505.

Use IP_PMTUDISC_OMIT if available. [RT #35494]

4504.

Allow the maximum number of records in a zone to
be specified. This provides a control for issues
raised in CVE-2016-6170. [RT #42143]

4503.

"make uninstall" now removes files installed by
BIND. (This currently excludes Python files
due to lack of support in setup.py.) [RT #42192]

4502.

Report multiple and experimental options when printing
grammar. [RT #43134]

4501.

4500.

Support modifier I64 in isc__print_printf. [RT #43526]

4499.

MacOSX: silence deprecated function warning
by using arc4random_stir() when available
instead of arc4random_addrandom(). [RT #43503]

4498.

Simplify prerequisite checks in system tests.
[RT #43516]

4497.

Add support for OpenSSL 1.1.0. [RT #41284]

4496.

dig: add +idnout to control whether labels are
display in punycode or not. Requires idn support
to be enabled at compile time. [RT #43398]

4495.

A isc_mutex_init call was not being checked.
[RT #43391]

4494.

Look for <editline/readline.h>. [RT #43429]

4493.

bin/tests/system/dyndb/driver/Makefile.in should use
SO_TARGETS. [RT# 43336]

4492.

irs_resconf_load failed to initialize sortlistnxt
causing bad writes if resolv.conf contained a
sortlist directive. [RT #43459]

4491.

Improve message emitted when testing whether sendmsg
works with TOS/TCLASS fails. [RT #43483]

4490.

Added AAAA (2001:500:12::d0d) for G.ROOT-SERVERS.NET.

4489.

It was possible to trigger assertions when processing
a response containing a DNAME answer. (CVE-2016-8864)
[RT #43465]

4488.

Darwin: use -framework for Kerberos. [RT #43418]

4487.

Make system tests work on Windows. [RT #42931]

4486.

Look in $prefix/lib/pythonX.Y/site-packages for
the python modules we install. [RT #43330]

4485.

Failure to find readline when requested should be
fatal to configure. [RT #43328]

4484.

Check prefixes in acls to make sure the address and
prefix lengths are consistent. Warn only in
BIND 9.11 and earlier. [RT #43367]

4483.

Address use before require check and remove extraneous
dns_message_gettsigkey call in dns_tsig_sign.
[RT #43374]

4482.

Change #4455 was incomplete. [RT #43252]

4481.

dig: make +class, +crypto, +multiline, +rrcomments,
+onesoa, +qr, +ttlid, +ttlunits and -u per lookup
rather than global. [RT #42450]

4480.

4479.

4478.

Add +continue option to mdig, allow continue on socket
errors. [RT #43281]

4477.

Fix mkeys test timing issues. [RT #41028]

4476.

Fix reclimit test on slower machines. [RT #43283]

4475.

When built with LMDB (Lightning Memory-mapped
Database), named will now use a database to store
the configuration for zones added by "rndc addzone"
instead of using a flat NZF file. This improves
performance of "rndc delzone" and "rndc modzone"
significantly. Existing NZF files will
automatically by converted to NZD databases.
To view the contents of an NZD or to roll back to
NZF format, use "named-nzd2nzf". To disable
this feature, use "configure --without-lmdb".
[RT #39837]

Added support for "dyndb", a new interface for loading

Red Hat for the FreeIPA project.
DynDB drivers fully implement the BIND database

performance and functionality than DLZ drivers,
while taking advantage of advanced database
features not available in BIND such as multi-master
replication.
Thanks to Adam Tkac and Petr Spacek of Red Hat.

4187.

When any RR type implementation doesn't
implement totext() for the RDATA's wire
representation and returns ISC_R_NOTIMPLEMENTED,
such RDATA is now printed in unknown
presentation format (RFC 3597). RR types affected
include LOC(29) and APL(42). [RT #40317].

4186.

Fixed an RPZ bug where a QNAME would be matched
against a policy RR with wildcard owner name
(trigger) where the QNAME was the wildcard owner
name's parent. For example, the bug caused a query
with QNAME "example.com" to match a policy RR with
"*.example.com" as trigger. [RT #40357]

4185.

Fixed an RPZ bug where a policy RR with wildcard
owner name (trigger) would prevent another policy RR
with its parent owner name from being
loaded. For example, the bug caused a policy RR
with trigger "example.com" to not have any
effect when a previous policy RR with trigger
"*.example.com" existed in that RPZ zone.
[RT #40357]

4184.

Fixed a possible memory leak in name compression
when rendering long messages. (Also, improved
wire_test for testing such messages.) [RT #40375]

4183.

Use timing-safe memory comparisons in cryptographic
code. Also, the timing-safe comparison functions have
been renamed to avoid possible confusion with
memcmp(). Thanks to Loganaden Velvindron of
AFRINIC. [RT #40148]

4182.

Use mnemonics for RR class and type comparisons.
[RT #40297]

4181.

Queued notify messages could be dequeued from the
wrong rate limiter queue. [RT #40350]

4180.

Error responses in pipelined queries could
cause a crash in client.c. [RT #40289]

Fix double frees in getaddrinfo() in libirs.

Fix assertion failure in parsing UNSPEC(103) RR from

Fix assertion failure in parsing NSAP records from

Address race issues with lwresd. [RT #40284]

TKEY with GSS-API keys needed bigger buffers.

"dnssec-coverage -r" didn't handle time unit

dig +sigchase was not properly matching the trusted

Fixed incorrect class checks in TSIG RR

Print informative output from rndc showzone when

Dig should zero non significant +subnet bits. Check

4152.

Implement DNS COOKIE option. This replaces the
experimental SIT option of BIND 9.10. The following
named.conf directives are available: send-cookie,
cookie-secret, cookie-algorithm, nocookie-udp-size
and require-server-cookie. The following dig options
are available: +[no]cookie[=value] and +[no]badcookie.
[RT #39928]

'rndc flush' could cause a deadlock. [RT #39835]

win32: listen-on-v6 { any; }; was not working.

Fixed a race condition in the getaddrinfo()

Alphabetize dig's help output. [RT #39966]

Apply

implementation in libirs, which caused the delv

the '@server' syntax with a hostname argument.

Fix a bug when printing zone names with '/' character

Address reference leak that could prevent a clean

Not all unassociated adb entries where being printed.

Log expired NTA at startup. [RT #39680]

Update how various json libraries are handled.

The server could match a shorter prefix than what was

On servers with one or more policy zones

assertion failure in rpz.c when further
incremental updates were made to the zone, such
as via IXFR. [RT #39567]

A bug in RPZ could cause the server to crash if

Check for Net::DNS is some system test

Inherited owernames on the line immediately following

Preserve the case of the owner name of records to

Add libjson-c version number reporting to

Initialize pthread mutex attrs just once, instead of

Reorganize options in the nsupdate man page.

Omit unknown serial number from JSON zone statistics.

Reduce noise from RRL when query logging is

Reorganize options in the dig man page. [RT #38516]

Additional RFC 5011 tests. [RT #38569]

dnssec-keyset.sh: Generates a specified number
of DNSSEC keys with timing set to implement a
pre-publication key rollover strategy. Thanks
to Jeffry A. Spain. [RT #38459]

4063.

Asynchronous zone loads were not handled
correctly when the zone load was already in

Fix an out-of-bounds read in RPZ code. If the

4061.

Handle timeout in legacy system test. [RT #38573]

dns_rdata_freestruct could be called on a

Addressed valgrind warnings. [RT #38549]

'dnssec-dsfromkey -T 0' failed to add ttl field.

Expanded automatic testing of trust anchor

"rndc managed-keys" can be used to check status

Also, the managed keys data file has easier-to-read

CDS and CDNSKEY had the wrong attributes. [RT #38491]

adb hash table was not being grown. [RT #38470]

Accounting of "total use" in memory context

Skip to next master on dns_request_createvia4 failure.

4041.

TCP sockets can now be shared while connecting.

4040.

Added server-side support for pipelined TCP
queries. Clients may continue sending queries via

TCP while previous queries are being processed
in parallel. (The new "keep-response-order"
option allows clients to be specified for which
the old behavior will still be used.) [RT #37821]
4039.

Cleaned up warnings from gcc -Wshadow. [RT #37381]

Add 'rpz' flag to node and use it to determine whether

also-notify was ignoring the tsig key when checking

Make call to open a temporary file name safe during

4035.

Close temporary and NZF FILE pointers before moving

When added, negative trust anchors (NTA) are now

Missing out of memory check in request.c:req_send.

Built-in "empty" zones did not correctly inherit the

$GENERATE with a zero step was not being caught as a

Net::DNS 0.81 compatibility. [RT #38165]

bsdi: failed to build. [RT #38047]

dns_rdata_opt_first, dns_rdata_opt_next,
dns_rdata_opt_current, dns_rdata_txt_first,
dns_rdata_txt_next and dns_rdata_txt_current were
documented but not implemented. These have now been
implemented.
dns_rdata_spf_first, dns_rdata_spf_next and

4006.

A flaw in delegation handling could be exploited
to put named into an infinite loop. This has
been addressed by placing limits on the number
of levels of recursion named will allow (default 7),
and the number of iterative queries that it will
send (default 50) before terminating a recursive
query (CVE-2014-8500).
The recursion depth limit is configured via the
"max-recursion-depth" option, and the query limit
via the "max-recursion-queries" option. [RT #37580]

4005.

The buffer used for returning text from rndc
commands is now dynamically resizable, allowing
arbitrarily large amounts of text to be sent back
to the client. (Prior to this change, it was
possible for the output of "rndc tsig-list" to be
truncated.) [RT #37731]

When delegations had AAAA glue but not A, a

4002.

Lookups in GeoIP databases that were not
loaded could cause an assertion failure

4001.

The caching of GeoIP lookups did not always

3999.

"mkeys" and "nzf" files are now named after
their corresponding views, unless the view name
contains characters that would be incompatible
with use in a filename (i.e., slash, backslash,
or capital letters). If a view name does contain
these characters, the files will still be named
using a cryptographic hash of the view name.
Regardless of this, if a file using the old name
format is found to exist, it will continue to be
used. [RT #37704]

receive_secure_serial holds the zone lock for too

3943.

SERVFAIL responses can now be cached for a
limited time (configured by "servfail-ttl",
default 10 seconds, limit 30). This can reduce
the frequency of retries when an authoritative
server is known to be failing, e.g., due to
ongoing DNSSEC validation problems. [RT #21347]

3938.

Added quotas to be used in recursive resolvers
that are under high query load for names in zones
whose authoritative servers are nonresponsive or
are experiencing a denial of service attack.
- "fetches-per-server" limits the number of
simultaneous queries that can be sent to any
single authoritative server. The configured
value is a starting point; it is automatically
adjusted downward if the server is partially or
completely non-responsive. The algorithm used to
adjust the quota can be configured via the
"fetch-quota-params" option.
- "fetches-per-zone" limits the number of
simultaneous queries that can be sent for names
within a single domain. (Note: Unlike
"fetches-per-server", this value is not
self-tuning.)
- New stats counters have been added to count
queries spilled due to these quotas.
See the ARM for details of these options. [RT #37125]

3937.

Added some debug logging to better indicate the
conditions causing SERVFAILs when resolving.
[RT #35538]

3936.

Added authoritative support for the EDNS Client
Subnet (ECS) option.
ACLs can now include "ecs" elements which specify
an address or network prefix; if an ECS option is
included in a DNS query, then the address encoded
in the option will be matched against "ecs" ACL
elements.
Also, if an ECS address is included in a query,
then it will be used instead of the client source
address when matching "geoip" ACL elements. This
behavior can be overridden with "geoip-use-ecs no;".
(Note: to enable "geoip" ACLs, use "configure
--with-geoip". This requires libGeoIP version
1.5.0 or higher.)
When "ecs" or "geoip" ACL elements are used to
select a view for a query, the response will include
an ECS option to indicate which client network the

answer is valid for.
(Thanks to Vincent Bernat.) [RT #36781]
3935.

can now match against the AS number alone (e.g.,

Fix sign extension bug in dns_name_fromtext when

Improved system test portability. [RT #35625]

3803.

"named-checkconf -z" incorrectly rejected zones

Various header files were not being installed.

Fix probing for gssapi support on FreeBSD. [RT #35615]

A pending event on the route socket could cause an

Improve named's command line error reporting.

'rndc zonestatus' was reporting the wrong re-signing

3797.

netbsd: geoip support probing was broken. [RT #35642]

3796.

Register dns and pkcs#11 error codes. [RT #35629]

3795.

Make named-checkconf detect raw masterfiles for

Added AAAA for C.ROOT-SERVERS.NET.

zone.c:save_nsec3param() could assert when out of

Provide links to the alternate statistics views when

3791.

Handle broken nameservers that send BADVERS in

Null pointer dereference on rbt creation failure.

dns_peer_getrequestsit was returning request_nsid by

--- 9.10.0b2 released --3787.

The code that checks whether "auto-dnssec" is
allowed was ignoring "allow-update" ACLs set at

3786.

Provide more detailed error codes when using
native PKCS#11. "pkcs11-tokens" now fails robustly

3785.

Debugging code dumphex didn't accept arbitrarily long
input (only compiled with -DDEBUG). [RT #35544]

3784.

Using "rrset-order fixed" when it had not been
enabled at compile time caused inconsistent
results. It now works as documented, defaulting

3783.

"tsig-keygen" is now available as an alternate

[RT #35503]

3782.

Specifying "auto" as the salt when using
"rndc signing -nsec3param" causes named to
generate a 64-bit salt at random. [RT #35322]

3781.

Use adaptive mutex locks when available; this
has been found to improve performance under load
on many systems. "configure --with-locktype=standard"
restores conventional mutex locks. [RT #32576]

3780.

$GENERATE handled negative numbers incorrectly.
[RT #25528]

3779.

Clarify the error message when using an option

3778.

Log a warning when the wrong address family is

EDNS EXPIRE code could dump core when processing

3776.

"rndc -q" suppresses output from successful

[RT #21393]

3775.

dlz_dlopen driver could return the wrong error
code on API version mismatch, leading to a segfault.
[RT #35495]

3774.

When using "request-nsid", log the NSID value in

3773.

"host", "nslookup" and "nsupdate" now have

[RT #26057]

3772.

Added sqlite3 dynamically-loadable DLZ module.

[RT #20822]

3771.

Adjusted log level for "using built-in key"
messages. [RT #24383]

"dig +trace" could fail with an assertion when it

Improved documentation of "rndc signing -list".

3768.

"dnssec-checkds" was missing the SHA-384 digest

Log explicitly when using rndc.key to configure

Fixed problems with building outside the source

Fixed a bug in "rndc secroots" that could crash

3764.

The dnssec-keygen/settime -S and -i options

delve: Cache DNSSEC records to avoid the need to

3762.

Address build problems with --pkcs11-native +

3761.

Address dangling reference bug in dns_keytable_add.

Improve SIT with native PKCS#11 and on Windows.

Enable delve on Windows. [RT #35441]

Enable export library APIs on Windows. [RT #35382]

Enable Python tools (dnssec-coverage,

GSSAPI Kerberos realm checking was broken in

--- 9.10.0b1 released --3755.

Add stats counters for known EDNS options + others.
[RT #35447]

3754.

win32: Installer now places files in the
Program Files area rather than system services.
[RT #35361]

3753.

allow-notify was ignoring keys. [RT #35425]

3752.

Address potential REQUIRE failure if
DNS_STYLEFLAG_COMMENTDATA is set when printing out
a rdataset.

3751.

The default setting for the -U option (setting
the number of UDP listeners per interface) has
been adjusted to improve performance. [RT #35417]

3750.

Partially implement EDNS EXPIRE option as described
in draft-andrews-dnsext-expire-00. Retrieval of
the remaining time until expiry for slave zones
is supported.
EXPIRE uses an experimental option code (65002),
which is subject to change. [RT #35416]

3749.

"dig +subnet" sends an EDNS client subnet option
containing the specified address/prefix when
querying. (Thanks to Wilmer van der Gaast.)
[RT #35415]

3748.

Use delve to test dns_client interfaces. [RT #35383]

3747.

A race condition could lead to a core dump when

destroying a resolver fetch object. [RT #35385]
3746.

New "max-zone-ttl" option enforces maximum
TTLs for zones. If loading a zone containing a
higher TTL, the load fails. DDNS updates with
higher TTLs are accepted but the TTL is truncated.
(Note: Currently supported for master zones only;
inline-signing slaves will be added.) [RT #38405]

3745.

"configure --with-tuning=large" adjusts various
compiled-in constants and default settings to
values suited to large servers with abundant
memory. [RT #29538]

3744.

SIT: send and process Source Identity Tokens
(similar to DNS Cookies by Donald Eastlake 3rd),
which are designed to help clients detect off-path
spoofed responses and for servers to identify
legitimate clients.
SIT uses an experimental EDNS option code (65001),
which will be changed to an IANA-assigned value
if the experiment is deemed a success.
SIT can be enabled via "configure --enable-sit" (or
--enable-developer). It is enabled by default in
Windows.
Servers can be configured to send smaller responses
to clients that have not identified themselves via
SIT. RRL processing has also been updated;
legitimate clients are not subject to rate
limiting. [RT #35389]

3743.

delegation-only flag wasn't working in forward zone
declarations despite being documented. This is
needed to support turning off forwarding and turning
on delegation only at the same name. [RT #35392]

3742.

linux: libcap support: declare curval at start of
block. [RT #35387]

3741.

"delve" (domain entity lookup and validation engine):
A new tool with dig-like semantics for performing DNS
lookups, with internal DNSSEC validation, using the
same resolver and validator logic as named. This
allows easy validation of DNSSEC data in environments
with untrustworthy resolvers, and assists with
troubleshooting of DNSSEC problems. [RT #32406]

3740.

Minor fixes to configure --with-dlz-bdb,
--with-dlz-postgres and --with-dlz-odbc. [RT #35340]

3739.

Added per-zone stats counters to track TCP and
UDP queries. [RT #35375]

3738.

--enable-openssl-hash failed to build. [RT #35343]

3737.

'rndc retransfer' could trigger a assertion failure
with inline zones. [RT #35353]

3736.

nsupdate: When specifying a server by name,
fall back to alternate addresses if the first
address for that name is not reachable. [RT #25784]

3735.

Merged the libiscpk11 library into libisc
to simplify dependencies. [RT #35205]

3734.

Improve building with libtool. [RT #35314]

3733.

Improve interface scanning support. Interface
information will be automatically updated if the
OS supports routing sockets (MacOS, *BSD, Linux).
Use "automatic-interface-scan no;" to disable.
Add "rndc scan" to trigger a scan. [RT #23027]

3732.

Fixed a type mismatch causing the ODBC DLZ
driver to dump core on 64-bit systems. [RT #35324]

3731.

Added a "no-case-compress" ACL, which causes
named to use case-insensitive compression
(disabling change #3645) for specified
clients. (This is useful when dealing
with broken client implementations that
use case-sensitive name comparisons,
rejecting responses that fail to match the
capitalization of the query that was sent.)
[RT #35300]

3730.

Added "never" as a synonym for "none" when
configuring key event dates in the dnssec tools.
[RT #35277]

3729.

dnssec-keygen could set the publication date
incorrectly when only the activation date was
specified on the command line. [RT #35278]

3728.

Expanded native-PKCS#11 documentation,
specifically pkcs11: URI labels. [RT #35287]

3727.

The isc_bitstring API is no longer used and
has been removed from libisc. [RT #35284]

3726.

Clarified the error message when attempting
to configure more than 32 response-policy zones.
[RT #35283]

3725.

Updated zkt and nslint to newest versions,
cleaned up and rearranged the contrib
directory, and added a README.

3707.

irs_resconf_load now returns ISC_R_FILENOTFOUND
on a missing resolv.conf file and initializes the
structure as if it had been configured with:
nameserver ::1
nameserver 127.0.0.1
Note: Callers will need to be updated to treat
ISC_R_FILENOTFOUND as a qualified success or else
they will leak memory. The following code fragment
will work with both old and new versions without
changing the behaviour of the existing code.
resconf = NULL;
result = irs_resconf_load(mctx, "/etc/resolv.conf",
&resconf);
if (result != ISC_SUCCESS) {
if (resconf != NULL)
irs_resconf_destroy(&resconf);
....
}
[RT #35194]

3706.

queryperf: Fixed a possible integer overflow when

3705.

"configure --enable-native-pkcs11" enables BIND
to use the PKCS#11 API for all cryptographic
functions, so that it can drive a hardware service
module directly without the need to use a modified
OpenSSL as intermediary (so long as the HSM's vendor
provides a complete-enough implementation of the
PKCS#11 interface). This has been tested successfully
with the Thales nShield HSM and with SoftHSMv2 from
the OpenDNSSEC project. [RT #29031]

3704.

Accept integer timestamps in RRSIG records. [RT #35185]

3703.

To improve recursive resolver performance, cache

records which are still being requested by clients
can now be automatically refreshed from the
authoritative server before they expire, reducing
or eliminating the time window in which no answer
is available in the cache. See the "prefetch" option
for more details. [RT #35041]
3702.

'dnssec-coverage -l' option specifies a length
of time to check for coverage; events further into
the future are ignored. 'dnssec-coverage -z'
checks only ZSK events, and 'dnssec-coverage -k'
checks only KSK events. (Thanks to Peter Palfrader.)
[RT #35168]

3701.

named-checkconf can now obscure shared secrets

Allow access to subgroups of XML statistics via

3699.

Improvements to statistics channel XSL stylesheet:

easier readability. [RT #35117]

3589.

Report serial numbers in when starting zone transfers.
Report accepted NOTIFY requests including serial.
[RT #33037]

3588.

dig: addressed a memory leak in the sigchase code
that could cause a shutdown crash. [RT #33733]

3587.

'named -g' now checks the logging configuration but
does not use it. [RT #33473]

3586.

Handle errors in xmlDocDumpFormatMemoryEnc. [RT #33706]

3585.

"rndc delzone -clean" option removes zone files
when deleting a zone. [RT #33570]

3584.

Caching data from an incompletely signed zone could
trigger an assertion failure in resolver.c
(CVE-2013-3919). [RT #33690]

3583.

Address memory leak in GSS-API processing [RT #33574]

3582.

Silence false positive warning regarding missing file
directive for inline slave zones. [RT #33662]

3581.

Changed the tcp-listen-queue default to 10. [RT #33029]

3580.

Addressed a possible race in acache.c [RT #33602]

3579.

Updates to PKCS#11 openssl patches, supporting
versions 0.9.8y, 1.0.0k, 1.0.1e [RT #33463]

3578.

'rndc -c file' now fails if 'file' does not exist.
[RT #33571]

3577.

Handle zero TTL values better. [RT #33411]

3576.

Address a shutdown race when validating. [RT #33573]

3575.

Changed the logging category for RRL events from
'queries' to 'query-errors'. [RT #33540]

3574.

The 'hostname' keyword was missing from server-id
description in the named.conf man page. [RT #33476]

3573.

"rndc addzone" and "rndc delzone" incorrectly handled

zone names containing punctuation marks and other
nonstandard characters. [RT #33419]
3572.

Threads are now enabled by default on most
operating systems. [RT #25483]

3571.

Address race condition in dns_client_startresolve().

3570.

Check internal pointers are valid when loading map
files. [RT #33403]

3569.

Ported mysql DLZ driver to dynamically-loadable
module, and added multithread support. [RT #33394]

3568.

Add a product description line to the version file,
to be reported by named -v/-V. [RT #33366]

3567.

Silence clang static analyzer warnings. [RT #33365]

3566.

Log when forwarding updates to master. [RT #33240]

3565.

3564.

Improved handling of corrupted map files. [RT #33380]

3563.

zone2sqlite failed with some table names. [RT #33375]

3562.

Update map file header format to include a SHA-1 hash
of the database content, so that corrupted map files
can be rejected at load time. [RT #32459]

dig: issue a warning if an EDNS query returns FORMERR
or NOTIMP. Adjust usage message. [RT #33363]

isc-config.sh did not honor includedir and libdir
when set via configure. [RT #33345]

3559.

Check that both forms of Sender Policy Framework
records exist or do not exist. [RT #33355]

3558.

IXFR of a DLZ stored zone was broken. [RT #33331]

3557.

Reloading redirect zones was broken. [RT #33292]

3556.

Added AAAA for D.ROOT-SERVERS.NET.

3555.

Address theoretical race conditions in acache.c
(change #3553 was incomplete). [RT #33252]

3554.

RRL failed to correctly rate-limit upward
referrals and failed to count dropped error

responses in the statistics. [RT #33225]
3553.

Address suspected double free in acache. [RT #33252]

3552.

Wrong getopt option string for 'nsupdate -r'.
[RT #33280]

3551.

resolver.querydscp[46] were uninitialized.

3550.

Unified the internal and export versions of the
BIND libraries, allowing external clients to use
the same libraries as BIND. [RT #33131]

3549.

Documentation for "request-nsid" was missing.
[RT #33153]

3548.

The NSID request code in resolver.c was broken
resulting in invalid EDNS options being sent.
[RT #33153]

3547.

Some malformed unknown rdata records were not properly
detected and rejected. [RT #33129]

3546.

Add EUI48 and EUI64 types. [RT #33082]

3545.

RRL slip behavior was incorrect when set to 1.
[RT #33111]

3544.

check5011.pl: Script to report the status of
managed keys as recorded in managed-keys.bind.
Contributed by Tony Finch <dot@dotat.at>

3543.

Update socket structure before attaching to socket
manager after accept. [RT #33084]

3542.

3541.

Parts of libdns were not properly initialized when
built in libexport mode. [RT #33028]

3540.

libt_api: t_info and t_assert were not thread safe.

3539.

win32: timestamp format didn't match other platforms.

3538.

Running "make test" now requires loopback interfaces
to be set up. [RT #32452]

3537.

Slave zones, when updated, now send NOTIFY messages
to peers before being dumped to disk rather than
after. [RT #27242]

3536.

Add support for setting Differentiated Services Code

[RT #32686]

Point (DSCP) values in named. Most configuration
options which take a "port" option (e.g.,
listen-on, forwarders, also-notify, masters,
notify-source, etc) can now also take a "dscp"
option specifying a code point for use with
outgoing traffic, if supported by the underlying
OS. [RT #27596]
3535.

Minor win32 cleanups. [RT #32962]

3534.

Extra text after an embedded NULL was ignored when
parsing zone files. [RT #32699]

3533.

query-loc-0.4.0: memory leaks. [RT #32960]

3532.

zkt: fixed buffer overrun, resource leaks. [RT #32960]

3531.

win32: A uninitialized value could be returned on out
of memory. [RT #32960]

3530.

Better RTT tracking in queryperf. [RT #30128]

3529.

Named now listens on both IPv4 and IPv6 interfaces
by default. Named previously only listened on IPv4
interfaces by default unless named was running in
IPv6 only mode. [RT #32945]

3528.

New "dnssec-coverage" command scans the timing
metadata for a set of DNSSEC keys and reports if a
lapse in signing coverage has been scheduled
inadvertently. (Note: This tool depends on python;
it will not be built or installed on systems that
do not have a python interpreter.) [RT #28098]

3527.

Add a URI to allow applications to explicitly
request a particular XML schema from the statistics
channel, returning 404 if not supported. [RT #32481]

3526.

Set up dependencies for unit tests correctly during
build. [RT #32803]

3525.

Support for additional signing algorithms in rndc:
hmac-sha1, -sha224, -sha256, -sha384, and -sha512.
The -A option to rndc-confgen can be used to
select the algorithm for the generated key.
(The default is still hmac-md5; this may
change in a future release.) [RT #20363]

3524.

Added an alternate statistics channel in JSON format,
when the server is built with the json-c library:
http://[address]:[port]/json. [RT #32630]

3523.

Ported filesystem and ldap DLZ drivers to
dynamically-loadable modules, and added the
"wildcard" module based on a contribution from
Vadim Goncharov <vgoncharov@nic.ru>. [RT #23569]

3522.

DLZ lookups could fail to return SERVFAIL when
they ought to. [RT #32685]

3521.

Address memory leak in opensslecdsa_link.c. [RT #32249]

3520.

'mctx' was not being referenced counted in some places
where it should have been. [RT #32794]

3519.

Full replay protection via four-way handshake is
now mandatory for rndc clients. Very old versions
of rndc will no longer work. [RT #32798]

3518.

Increase the size of dns_rrl_key.s.rtype by one bit
so that all dns_rrl_rtype_t enum values fit regardless
of whether it is treated as signed or unsigned by
the compiler. [RT #32792]

3517.

Reorder destruction to avoid shutdown race. [RT #32777]

3516.

3515.

'%T' is not portable in strftime(). [RT #32763]

3514.

The ranges for valid key sizes in ddns-confgen and
rndc-confgen were too constrained. Keys up to 512
bits are now allowed for most algorithms, and up
to 1024 bits for hmac-sha384 and hmac-sha512.
[RT #32753]

3513.

"dig -u" prints times in microseconds rather than
milliseconds. [RT #32704]

3512.

"rndc validation check" reports the current status
of DNSSEC validation. [RT #21397]

3511.

Improve documentation of redirect zones. [RT #32756]

3510.

"rndc status" and XML statistics channel now report
server start and reconfiguration times. [RT #21048]

3509.

Added a product line to version file to allow for
easy naming of different products (BIND
vs BIND ESV, for example). [RT #32755]

3508.

queryperf was incorrectly rejecting the -T option.
[RT #32338]

3507.

Statistics channel XSL had a glitch when attempting
to chart query data before any queries had been
received. [RT #32620]

3506.

When setting "max-cache-size" and "max-acache-size",
the keyword "unlimited" is no longer defined as equal
to 4 gigabytes (except on 32-bit platforms); it
means literally unlimited. [RT #32358]

3505.

When setting "max-cache-size" and "max-acache-size",
larger values than 4 gigabytes could not be set
explicitly, though larger sizes were available
when setting cache size to 0. This has been
corrected; the full range is now available.
[RT #32358]

3504.

Add support for ACLs based on geographic location,
using MaxMind GeoIP databases. Based on code
contributed by Ken Brownfield <kb@slide.com>.
[RT #30681]

3503.

Clarify size_spec syntax. [RT #32449]

3502.

zone-statistics: "no" is now a synonym for "none",
instead of "terse". [RT #29165]

3501.

zone-statistics now takes three options: full,
terse, and none. "yes" and "no" are retained as
synonyms for full and terse, respectively. [RT #29165]

3500.

Support NAPTR regular expression validation on
all platforms without using libregex, which
can be vulnerable to memory exhaustion attack
(CVE-2013-2266). [RT #32688]

3499.

Corrected ARM documentation of built-in zones.
[RT #32694]

3498.

zone statistics for zones which matched a potential
empty zone could have their zone-statistics setting
overridden.

3497.

When deleting a slave/stub zone using 'rndc delzone'
report the files that were being used so they can
be cleaned up if desired. [RT #27899]

3496.

3495.

Support multiple response-policy zones (up to 32),
while improving RPZ performance. "response-policy"
syntax now includes a "min-ns-dots" clause, with
default 1, to exclude top-level domains from

NSIP and NSDNAME checking. --enable-rpz-nsip and
--enable-rpz-nsdname are now the default. [RT #32251]
3494.

DNS RRL: Blunt the impact of DNS reflection and
amplification attacks by rate-limiting substantiallyidentical responses. [RT #28130]

3493.

Added BDBHPT dynamically-loadable DLZ module,
contributed by Mark Goldfinch. [RT #32549]

3492.

Fixed a regression in zone loading performance
due to lock contention. [RT #30399]

3491.

Slave zones using inline-signing must specify a
file name. [RT #31946]

3490.

When logging RDATA during update, truncate if it's
too long. [RT #32365]

3489.

--enable-developer now turns on ISC_LIST_CHECKINIT.
dns_dlzcreate() failed to properly initialize
dlzdb.link. When cloning a rdataset do not copy
the link contents. [RT #32651]

3488.

Use after free error with DH generated keys. [RT #32649]

3487.

Change 3444 was not complete. There was a additional
place where the NOQNAME proof needed to be saved.
[RT #32629]

3486.

named could crash when using TKEY-negotiated keys
that had been deleted and then recreated. [RT #32506]

3485.

Only compile openssl_gostlink.c if we support GOST.

3484.

Some statistics were incorrectly rendered in XML.
[RT #32587]

3483.

3482.

dig +nssearch now prints name servers that don't
have address records (missing AAAA or A, or the name
doesn't exist). [RT #29348]

3481.

Removed use of const const in atf.

3480.

Silence logging noise when setting up zone
statistics. [RT #32525]

3479.

Address potential memory leaks in gssapi support
code. [RT #32405]

3478.

Fix a build failure in strict C99 environments
[RT #32475]

3477.

Expand logging when adding records via DDNS update
[RT #32365]

3476.

"rndc zonestatus" could report a spurious "not
found" error on inline-signing zones. [RT #29226]

3475.

Changed name of 'map' zone file format (previously
'fast'). [RT #32458]

3474.

nsupdate could assert when the local and remote
address families didn't match. [RT #22897]

3473.

dnssec-signzone/verify could incorrectly report
an error condition due to an empty node above an
opt-out delegation lacking an NSEC3. [RT #32072]

3472.

The active-connections counter in the socket
statistics could underflow. [RT #31747]

3471.

The number of UDP dispatches now defaults to
the number of CPUs even if -n has been set to
a higher value. [RT #30964]

3470.

Slave zones could fail to dump when successfully
refreshing after an initial failure. [RT #31276]

3469.

Handle DLZ lookup failures more gracefully. Improve
backward compatibility between versions of DLZ dlopen
API. [RT #32275]

3468.

RPZ rules to generate A records (but not AAAA records)
could trigger an assertion failure when used in
conjunction with DNS64 (CVE-2012-5689). [RT #32141]

3467.

Added checks in dnssec-keygen and dnssec-settime
to check for delete date < inactive date. [RT #31719]

3466.

Corrected the DNS_CLIENTINFOMETHODS_VERSION check
in DLZ example driver. [RT #32275]

3465.

Handle isolated reserved ports. [RT #31778]

3464.

Updates to PKCS#11 openssl patches, supporting
versions 0.9.8x, 1.0.0j, 1.0.1c [RT #29749]

3463.

Clarify managed-keys syntax in ARM. [RT #32232]

3462.

Clarify server selection behavior of dig when using
-4 or -6 options. [RT #32181]

3461.

Negative responses could incorrectly have AD=1
set. [RT #32237]

3460.

Only link against readline where needed. [RT #29810]

3459.

Added -J option to named-checkzone/named-compilezone
to specify the path to the journal file. [RT #30958]

3458.

Return FORMERR when presented with a overly long

3457.

Add ILNP records (NID, LP, L32, L64). [RT #31836]

g++47: ATF failed to compile. [RT #32012]

3455.

queryperf: fix getopt option list. [RT #32338]

3454.

sparc64: improve atomic support. [RT #25182]

3453.

'rndc addzone' of a zone with 'inline-signing yes;'
failed. [RT #31960]

3452.

Accept duplicate singleton records. [RT #32329]

3451.

Increase per thread stack size from 64K to 1M.

3450.

Stop logfileconfig system test spam system logs.

3449.

gen.c: use the pre-processor to construct format
strings so that compiler can perform sanity checks;

3448.

The allow-query-on ACL was not processed correctly.

3447.

Add support for libxml2-2.9.x [RT #32231]

3446.

win32: Add source ID (see change #3400) to build.

3445.

Warn about zone files with blank owner names
immediately after $ORIGIN directives. [RT #31848]

3444.

The NOQNAME proof was not being returned from cached
insecure responses. [RT #21409]

3443.

ddns-confgen: Some TSIG algorithms were incorrectly
rejected when generating keys. [RT #31927]

3442.

Net::DNS 0.69 introduced a non backwards compatible
change. [RT #32216]

3441.

D.ROOT-SERVERS.NET is now 199.7.91.13.

3440.

Reorder get_key_struct to not trigger a assertion when
cleaning up due to out of memory error. [RT #32131]

3439.

3438.

Don't accept unknown data escape in quotes. [RT #32031]

3437.

isc_buffer_init -> isc_buffer_constinit to initialize
buffers with constant data. [RT #32064]

3436.

Check malloc/calloc return values. [RT #32088]

3435.

Cross compilation support in configure was broken.
[RT #32078]

3434.

Pass client info to the DLZ findzone() entry
point in addition to lookup(). This makes it
possible for a database to answer differently
whether it's authoritative for a name depending
on the address of the client. [RT #31775]

3433.

dlz_findzone() did not correctly handle
ISC_R_NOMORE. [RT #31172]

3432.

Multiple DLZ databases can now be configured.
DLZ databases are searched in the order configured,
unless set to "search no", in which case a
zone can be configured to be retrieved from a
particular DLZ database by using a "dlz <name>"
option in the zone statement. DLZ databases can
support type "master" and "redirect" zones.
[RT #27597]

3431.

ddns-confgen: Some valid key algorithms were
not accepted. [RT #31927]

3430.

win32: isc_time_formatISO8601 was missing the
'T' between the date and time. [RT #32044]

3429.

dns_zone_getserial2 could a return success without
returning a valid serial. [RT #32007]

3428.

dig: Add timezone to date output. [RT #2269]

3427.

dig +trace incorrectly displayed name server
addresses instead of names. [RT #31641]

3426.

dnssec-checkds: Clearer output when records are not
found. [RT #31968]

3425.

"acacheentry" reference counting was broken resulting
in use after free. [RT #31908]

3424.

dnssec-dsfromkey now emits the hash without spaces.

3423.

"rndc signing -nsec3param" didn't accept the full

3422.

Added a clear error message for when the SOA does not
match the referral. [RT #31281]

3421.

Named loops when re-signing if all keys are offline.

3420.

Address VPATH compilation issues. [RT #31879]

3419.

Memory leak on validation cancel. [RT #31869]

3418.

New XML schema (version 3.0) for the statistics channel
adds query type statistics at the zone level, and
flattens the XML tree and uses compressed format to
optimize parsing. Includes new XSL that permits
charting via the Google Charts API on browsers that
support javascript in XSL. The old XML schema has been
deprecated. [RT #30023]

3417.

3416.

Named could die on shutdown if running with 128 UDP
dispatches per interface. [RT #31743]

3415.

named could die with a REQUIRE failure if a validation
was canceled. [RT #31804]

3414.

Address locking issues found by Coverity. [RT #31626]

3413.

Record the number of DNS64 AAAA RRsets that have been
synthesized. [RT #27636]

3412.

Copy timeval structure from control message data.
[RT #31548]

3411.

Use IPV6_USE_MIN_MTU or equivalent with TCP in addition
to UDP. [RT #31690]

3410.

Addressed Coverity warnings. [RT #31626]

3409.

contrib/dane/mkdane.sh: Tool to generate TLSA RR's
from X.509 certificates, for use with DANE
(DNS-based Authentication of Named Entities).
[RT #30513]

3408.

Some DNSSEC-related options (update-check-ksk,
dnssec-loadkeys-interval, dnssec-dnskey-kskonly)
are now legal in slave zones as long as
inline-signing is in use. [RT #31078]

3407.

3406.

mem.c: Fix compilation errors when building with
ISC_MEM_TRACKLINES or ISC_MEMPOOL_NAMES disabled.
Also, ISC_MEM_DEBUG is no longer optional. [RT #31559]

3405.

Handle time going backwards in acache. [RT #31253]

3404.

dnssec-signzone: When re-signing a zone, remove
RRSIG and NSEC records from nodes that used to be
in-zone but are now below a zone cut. [RT #31556]

3403.

Silence noisy OpenSSL logging. [RT #31497]

3402.

The IPv6 interface numbers used for system
tests were incorrect on some platforms. [RT #25085]

3401.

Addressed Coverity warnings. [RT #31484]

3400.

"named -V" can now report a source ID string, defined
in the "srcid" file in the build tree and normally set
to the most recent git hash. [RT #31494]

3399.

netbsd: rename 'bool' parameter to avoid namespace
clash. [RT #31515]

3398.

SOA parameters were not being updated with inline
signed zones if the zone was modified while the
server was offline. [RT #29272]

3397.

dig crashed when using +nssearch with +tcp. [RT #25298]

3396.

OPT records were incorrectly removed from signed,
truncated responses. [RT #31439]

3395.

Add RFC 6598 reverse zones to built in empty zones
list, 64.100.IN-ADDR.ARPA ... 127.100.IN-ADDR.ARPA.

3394.

Adjust 'successfully validated after lower casing
signer' log level and category. [RT #31414]

3393.

'host -C' could core dump if REFUSED was received.
[RT #31381]

3392.

Keep statistics on REFUSED responses. [RT #31412]

3391.

A DNSKEY lookup that encountered a CNAME failed.
[RT #31262]

3390.

Silence clang compiler warnings. [RT #30417]

3389.

Always return NOERROR (not 0) in TSIG. [RT #31275]

3388.

Fixed several Coverity warnings.
Note: This change includes a fix for a bug that
was subsequently determined to be an exploitable
security vulnerability, CVE-2012-5688: named could
die on specific queries with dns64 enabled.
[RT #30996]

3387.

DS digest can be disabled at runtime with
disable-ds-digests. [RT #21581]

3386.

Address locking violation when generating new NSEC /
NSEC3 chains. [RT #31224]

3385.

named-checkconf didn't detect missing master lists
in also-notify clauses. [RT #30810]

3384.

Improved logging of crypto errors. [RT #30963]

3383.

A certain combination of records in the RBT could
cause named to hang while populating the additional
section of a response. [RT #31090]

3382.

SOA query from slave used use-v6-udp-ports range,
if set, regardless of the address family in use.
[RT #24173]

3381.

Update queryperf to support more RR types.
[RT #30762]

3380.

named could die if a nonexistent master list was
referenced in a also-notify. [RT #31004]

3379.

isc_interval_zero and isc_time_epoch should be
"const (type)* const". [RT #31069]

3378.

Handle missing 'managed-keys-directory' better.
[RT #30625]

3377.

Removed spurious newline from NSEC3 multiline
output. [RT #31044]

3376.

Lack of EDNS support was being recorded without a
successful response. [RT #30811]

3375.

'rndc dumpdb' failed on empty caches. [RT #30808]

3374.

isc_parse_uint32 failed to return a range error on
systems with 64 bit longs. [RT #30232]

3373.

win32: open raw files in binary mode. [RT #30944]

3372.

Silence spurious "deleted from unreachable cache"
messages. [RT #30501]

3371.

AD=1 should behave like DO=1 when deciding whether to
add NS RRsets to the additional section or not.
[RT #30479]

3370.

Address use after free while shutting down. [RT #30241]

3369.

nsupdate terminated unexpectedly in interactive mode
if built with readline support. [RT #29550]

3368.

<dns/iptable.h>, <dns/private.h> and <dns/zone.h>

3367.

dns_dnsseckey_create() result was not being checked.

3366.

Fixed Read-After-Write dependency violation for IA64
atomic operations. [RT #25181]

3365.

Removed spurious newlines from log messages in

3364.

Named could die on specially crafted record.

Need to allow "forward" and "fowarders" options
in static-stub zones; this had been overlooked.

Setting some option values to 0 in named.conf

3361.

"rndc signing -nsec3param" didn't work correctly
when salt was set to '-' (no salt). [RT #30099]

3360.

'host -w' could die.

An improperly-formed TSIG secret could cause a

[RT #18723]

memory leak. [RT #30607]
3358.

3357.

Add support for libxml2-2.8.x [RT #30440]

Cap the TTL of signed RRsets when RRSIGs are

Use more portable awk in verify system test.

Improve OpenSSL error logging. [RT #29932]

Use a single task for task exclusive operations.

Ensure that learned server attributes timeout of the

Memory read overrun in isc___mem_reallocate if

Change #3345 was incomplete. [RT #30233]

Prevent RRSIG data from being cached if a negative

'map' zone files cannot always be transferred from one

unsigned and signed versions of the zone, which may
have different serial numbers.

2937.

Worked around an apparent race condition in over
memory conditions. Without this fix a DNS cache DB or
ADB could incorrectly stay in an over memory state,
effectively refusing further caching, which
subsequently made a BIND 9 caching server unworkable.
This fix prevents this problem from happening by
polling the state of the memory context, rather than
making a copy of the state, which appeared to cause
a race. This is a "workaround" in that it doesn't
solve the possible race per se, but several experiments
proved this change solves the symptom. Also, the
polling overhead hasn't been reported to be an issue.
This bug should only affect a caching server that
specifies a finite max-cache-size. It's also quite
likely that the bug happens only when enabling threads,
but it's not confirmed yet. [RT #21818]

2936.

Improved configuration syntax and multiple-view
support for addzone/delzone feature (see change
#2930). Removed "new-zone-file" option, replaced
with "allow-new-zones (yes|no)". The new-zone-file
for each view is now created automatically, with
a filename generated from a hash of the view name.
It is no longer necessary to "include" the
new-zone-file in named.conf; this happens
automatically. Zones that were not added via
"rndc addzone" can no longer be removed with
"rndc delzone". [RT #19447]

will be written into that file. To make the new

is expected to change.) [RT #19447]

records prior to signing the RRset.
named-checkzone -r {ignore|warn|fail} (default warn)

2712.

New 'auto-dnssec' zone option allows zone signing
to be fully automated in zones configured for
dynamic DNS. 'auto-dnssec allow;' permits a zone
to be signed by creating keys for it in the
key-directory and using 'rndc sign <zone>'.
'auto-dnssec maintain;' allows that too, plus it
also keeps the zone's DNSSEC keys up to date
according to their timing metadata. [RT #19943]

2710.

New 'dnssec-signzone -x' flag and 'dnskey-ksk-only'
zone option cause a zone to be signed with only KSKs
signing the DNSKEY RRset, not ZSKs. This reduces
the size of a DNSKEY answer. [RT #20340]

2709.

Added some data fields, currently unused, to the
private key file format, to allow implementation
of explicit key rollover in a future release
without impairing backward or forward compatibility.
[RT #20310]

2708.

Insecure to secure and NSEC3 parameter changes via
update are now fully supported and no longer require
defines to enable. We now no longer overload the
NSEC3PARAM flag field, nor the NSEC OPT bit at the
apex. Secure to insecure changes are controlled by
by the named.conf option 'secure-to-insecure'.

Warning: If you had previously enabled support by
adding defines at compile time to BIND 9.6 you should
ensure that all changes that are in progress have
completed prior to upgrading to BIND 9.7. BIND 9.7
is not backwards compatible.
2707.

dnssec-keyfromlabel no longer require engine name
to be specified in the label if there is a default
engine or the -E option has been used. Also, it
now uses default algorithms as dnssec-keygen does
(i.e., RSASHA1, or NSEC3RSASHA1 if -3 is used).
[RT #20371]

Changes to key metadata behavior:
- Keys without "publish" or "active" dates set will
no longer be used for smart signing. However,

those dates will be set to "now" by default when
a key is created; to generate a key but not use
it yet, use dnssec-keygen -G.
- New "inactive" date (dnssec-keygen/settime -I)
sets the time when a key is no longer used for
signing but is still published.
- The "unpublished" date (-U) is deprecated in
favor of "deleted" (-D).
[RT #20247]

2636.

they are scheduled to be published, activated,

2608.

Perform post signing verification checks in
dnssec-signzone. These can be disabled with -P.
The post sign verification test ensures that for each
algorithm in use there is at least one non revoked

self signed. That all records in the zone are signed
by the algorithm. [RT #19653]

ARM out-of-date on empty reverse zones (list includes

than an io completion port type for UDP.

A lock could be destroyed twice. [RT #18626]

isc_radix_insert() could copy radix tree nodes

named-checkconf used an incorrect test to determine

Potential NULL dereference in dns_acl_isanyornone().

Timeouts could be logged incorrectly under win32.

Sockets could be closed too early, leading to

Fixed an ACL memory leak affecting win32.

Fixed a minor error-reporting bug in
lib/isc/win32/socket.c.

Set initial timeout to 800ms.

2432.

More Windows socket handling improvements. Stop
using I/O events and use IO Completion Ports
throughout. Rewrite the receive path logic to make
it easier to support multiple simultaneous
requesters in the future. Add stricter consistency
checking as a compile-time option (define
ISC_SOCKET_CONSISTENCY_CHECKS; defaults to off).

Acl processing could leak memory. [RT #18323]

win32: isc_interval_set() could round down to

nanoseconds. Round up instead. [RT #18549]

nsupdate should be in section 1 of the man pages.

dns_iptable_merge() mishandled merges of negative

Treat DNSKEY queries as if "minimal-response yes;"

named didn't detect unavailable query source addresses

configure now probes for a working epoll

Randomize server selection on queries, so as to
make forgery a little more difficult. Instead of

Handle the special return value of a empty node as

Add new command line option '-S' for named to specify

Windows socket handling cleanup. Let the io
completion event send out canceled read/write
done events, which keeps us from writing to memory
we no longer have ownership of. Add debugging
socket_log() function. Rework TCP socket handling
to not leak sockets.

Document that isc_socket_create() and isc_socket_open()

--- 9.5.0a6 released --2206.

"allow-query-cache" and "allow-recursion" now
cross inherit from each other.
If allow-query-cache is not set in named.conf then
allow-recursion is used if set, otherwise allow-query
is used if set, otherwise the default (localnets;
localhost;) is used.
If allow-recursion is not set in named.conf then
allow-query-cache is used if set, otherwise allow-query
is used if set, otherwise the default (localnets;
localhost;) is used.
[RT #16987]

2010.

rt15958

2009.

libbind: Coverity fixes. [RT #15808]

2008.

It is now possible to enable/disable DNSSEC
validation from rndc. This is useful for the
mobile hosts where the current connection point
breaks DNSSEC (firewall/proxy). [RT #15592]
rndc validation newstate [view]

2007.

It is now possible to explicitly enable DNSSEC
validation. default dnssec-validation no; to
be changed to yes in 9.5.0. [RT #15674]

2006.

Allow-query-cache and allow-recursion now default
to the built in acls "localnets" and "localhost".
This is being done to make caching servers less
attractive as reflective amplifying targets for
spoofed traffic. This still leave authoritative
servers exposed.
The best fix is for full BCP 38 deployment to
remove spoofed traffic.

2005.

libbind: Retransmission timeouts should be
based on which attempt it is to the nameserver
and not the nameserver itself. [RT #13548]

2004.

dns_tsig_sign() could pass a NULL pointer to
dst_context_destroy() when cleaning up after a
error. [RT #15835]

2003.

libbind: The DNS name/address lookup functions could
occasionally follow a random pointer due to
structures not being completely zeroed. [RT #15806]

2002.

libbind: tighten the constraints on when
struct addrinfo._ai_pad exists. [RT #15783]

2001.

Check the KSK flag when updating a secure dynamic zone.
New zone option "update-check-ksk yes;". [RT #15817]

2000.

memmove()/strtol() fix was incomplete. [RT #15812]

1999.

Implement "rrset-order fixed". [RT #13662]

Restrict handling of fifos as sockets to just SunOS.

daemons that use fifos instead of sockets. [RT #15840]

1985.

DLV has now been assigned a official type code of
32769. [RT #15807]
Note: care should be taken to ensure you upgrade
both named and dnssec-signzone at the same time for
zones with DLV records where named is the master
server for the zone. Also any zones that contain
DLV records should be removed when upgrading a slave
zone. You do not however have to upgrade all
servers for a zone with DLV records simultaneously.

Two new update policies.

"selfsub" and "selfwild".
