The maximum EDNS UDP response named will send can
now be set in named.conf (max-udp-size). This is
independent of the advertised receive buffer
(edns-udp-size). [RT #14852]

1952.

hpux: tell the linker to build a runtime link
path "-Wl,+b:". [RT #14816].

1951.

Drop queries from particular well known ports.
Don't return FORMERR to queries from particular
well known ports. [RT #15636]

1950.

Solaris 2.5.1 and earlier cannot bind() then connect()
a TCP socket. This prevents the source address being
set for TCP connections. [RT #15628]

1949.

Addition memory leakage checks. [RT #15544]

1948.

If was possible to trigger a REQUIRE failure in
xfrin.c:maybe_free() if named ran out of memory.
[RT #15568]

1947.

It is now possible to configure named to accept
expired RRSIGs. Default "dnssec-accept-expired no;".
Setting "dnssec-accept-expired yes;" leaves named
vulnerable to replay attacks. [RT #14685]

1946.

resume_dslookup() could trigger a REQUIRE failure
when using forwarders. [RT #15549]

1945.

dnssec-keygen: RSA (RSAMD5) is no longer recommended.
To generate a RSAMD5 key you must explicitly request
RSAMD5. [RT #13780]

1944.

isc_hash_create() does not need a read/write lock.
[RT #15522]

1943.

Set the loadtime after rolling forward the journal.
[RT #15647]

1942.

If the name of a DNSKEY match that of one in
trusted-keys do not attempt to validate the DNSKEY
using the parents DS RRset. [RT #15649]

1941.

ncache_adderesult() should set eresult even if no
rdataset is passed to it. [RT #15642]

1940.

Fixed a number of error conditions reported by
Coverity.

1939.

The resolver could dereference a null pointer after
validation if all the queries have timed out.
[RT #15528]

1938.

The validator was not correctly handling unsecure
negative responses at or below a SEP. [RT #15528]

1937.

sdlz doesn't handle RRSIG records. [RT #15564]

1936.

The validator could leak memory. [RT #15544]

1935.

'acache' was DO sensitive. [RT #15430]

1934.

Validate pending NS RRsets, in the authority section,
prior to returning them if it can be done without
requiring DNSKEYs to be fetched. [RT #15430]

1933.

dump_rdataset_raw() had a incorrect INSIST. [RT #15534]

1932.

hpux: LDFLAGS was getting corrupted. [RT #15530]

1931.

Per-client mctx could require a huge amount of memory,
particularly for a busy caching server. [RT #15519]

1930.

HPUX: ia64 support. [RT #15473]

1929.

FreeBSD: extend use of PTHREAD_SCOPE_SYSTEM.

1928.

Race in rbtdb.c:currentversion(). [RT #15517]

1927.

Access to soanode or nsnode in rbtdb violated the
lock order rule and could cause a dead lock.
[RT #15518]

1926.

The Windows installer did not check for empty
passwords. BINDinstall was being installed in
the wrong place. [RT #15483]

1925.

All outer level AC_TRY_RUNs need cross compiling
defaults. [RT #15469]

1924.

libbind: hpux ia64 support. [RT #15473]

1923.

ns_client_detach() called too early. [RT #15499]

1922.

check-tool.c:setup_logging() missing call to
dns_log_setcontext().

1921.

Client memory contexts were not using internal
malloc. [RT #15434]

1920.

The cache rbtdb lock array was too small to
have the desired performance characteristics.
[RT #15454]

1919.

queryperf: a set of new features: collecting/printing
response delays, printing intermediate results, and
adjusting query rate for the "target" qps.

1918.

Memory leak when checking acls. [RT #15391]

1917.

funcsynopsisinfo wasn't being treated as verbatim
when generating man pages. [RT #15385]

1916.

Integrate contributed IDN code from JPNIC. [RT #15383]

1915.

dig +ndots was broken. [RT #15215]

1914.

DS is required to accept mnemonic algorithms

(RFC 4034). Still emit numeric algorithms for
compatibility with RFC 3658. [RT #15354]
1913.

Integrate contributed DLZ code into named. [RT #11382]

1912.

aix: atomic locking for powerpc. [RT #15020]

1911.

Update windows socket code. [RT #14965]

1910.

dig's +sigchase code overhauled. [RT #14933]

1909.

The DLV code has been re-worked to make no longer
query order sensitive. [RT #14933]

1908.

dig now warns if 'RA' is not set in the answer when
'RD' was set in the query. host/nslookup skip servers
that fail to set 'RA' when 'RD' is set unless a server
is explicitly set. [RT #15005]

1907.

host/nslookup now continue (default)/fail on SERVFAIL.
[RT #15006]

1906.

dig now has a '-q queryname' and '+showsearch' options.
[RT #15034]

1905.

Strings returned from cfg_obj_asstring() should be
treated as read-only. The prototype for
cfg_obj_asstring() has been updated to reflect this.
[RT #15256]

1904.

Automatic empty zone creation for D.F.IP6.ARPA and
friends. Note: RFC 1918 zones are not yet covered by
this but are likely to be in a future release.
New options: empty-server, empty-contact,
empty-zones-enable and disable-empty-zone.

1903.

ISC string copy API.

1902.

Attempt to make the amount of work performed in a
iteration self tuning. The covers nodes clean from
the cache per iteration, nodes written to disk when
rewriting a master file and nodes destroyed per
iteration when destroying a zone or a cache.
[RT #14996]

1901.

Don't add DNSKEY records to the additional section.

1900.

ixfr-from-differences failed to ensure that the
serial number increased. [RT #15036]

1899.

named-checkconf now validates update-policy entries.

[RT #14963]
1898.

Extend ISC_SOCKADDR_FORMATSIZE and
ISC_NETADDR_FORMATSIZE to allow for scope details.

1897.

x86 and x86_64 now have separate atomic locking
implementations.

1896.

Recursive clients soft quota support wasn't working
as expected. [RT #15103]

1895.

A escaped character is, potentially, converted to
the output character set too early. [RT #14666]

1894.

Review ARM for BIND 9.4.

1893.

Use uintptr_t if available. [RT #14606]

1892.

Support for SPF rdata type. [RT #15033]

1891.

freebsd: pthread_mutex_init can fail if it runs out
of memory. [RT #14995]

1890.

Raise the UDP receive buffer size to 32k if it is
less than 32k. [RT #14953]

1889.

sunos: non blocking i/o support. [RT #14951]

1888.

Support for IPSECKEY rdata type. [RT #14967]

1887.

The cache could delete expired records too fast for
clients with a virtual time in the past. [RT #14991]

1886.

fctx_create() could return success even though it
failed. [RT #14993]

1885.

dig: report the number of extra bytes still left in
the packet after processing all the records.

1884.

dighost.c: move external declarations into <dig/dig.h>.

1883.

dnssec-signzone, dnssec-keygen: handle negative debug
levels. [RT #14962]

1882.

Limit the number of recursive clients that can be
waiting for a single query (<qname,qtype,qclass>) to
resolve. New options clients-per-query and
max-clients-per-query.

1881.

Add a system test for named-checkconf. [RT #14931]

1880.

The lame cache is now done on a <qname,qclass,qtype>

basis as some servers only appear to be lame for
certain query types. [RT #14916]
1879.

"USE INTERNAL MALLOC" is now runtime selectable.
[RT #14892]

1878.

Detect duplicates of UDP queries we are recursing on
and drop them. New stats category "duplicate".
[RT #2471]

1877.

Fix unreasonably low quantum on call to
dns_rbt_destroy2(). Remove unnecessary unhash_node()
call. [RT #14919]

1876.

Additional memory debugging support to track size
and mctx arguments. [RT #14814]

1875.

process_dhtkey() was using the wrong memory context
to free some memory. [RT #14890]

1874.

sunos: portability fixes. [RT #14814]

1873.

win32: isc__errno2result() now reports its caller.
[RT #13753]

1872.

win32: Handle ERROR_NETNAME_DELETED.

1871.

1870.

Added framework for handling multiple EDNS versions.
[RT #14873]

1869.

dig can now specify the EDNS version when making
a query. [RT #14873]

1868.

edns-udp-size can now be overridden on a per
server basis. [RT #14851]

1867.

It was possible to trigger a INSIST in
dlv_validatezonekey(). [RT #14846]

1866.

resolv.conf parse errors were being ignored by
dig/host/nslookup. [RT #14841]

1865.

Silently ignore nameservers in /etc/resolv.conf with
bad addresses. [RT #14841]

1864.

Don't try the alternative transfer source if you
got a answer / transfer with the main source
address. [RT #14802]

1863.

rrset-order "fixed" error messages not complete.

[RT #13753]

1862.

Add additional zone data constancy checks.
named-checkzone has extended checking of NS, MX and
SRV record and the hosts they reference.
named has extended post zone load checks.
New zone options: check-mx and integrity-check.
[RT #4940]

1861.

dig could trigger a INSIST on certain malformed
responses. [RT #14801]

1860.

solaris 2.8: hack_shutup_pthreadmutexinit was
incorrectly set. [RT #14775]

1859.

Add support for CH A record. [RT #14695]

1858.

The flush-zones-on-shutdown option wasn't being
parsed. [RT #14686]

1857.

named could trigger a INSIST() if reconfigured /
reloaded too fast. [RT #14673]

1856.

Switch Docbook toolchain from DSSSL to XSL.
[RT #11398]

1855.

ixfr-from-differences was failing to detect changes
of ttl due to dns_diff_subtract() was ignoring the ttl
of records. [RT #14616]

1854.

lwres also needs to know the print format for
(long long). [RT #13754]

1853.

Rework how DLV interacts with proveunsecure().
[RT #13605]

1852.

Remove last vestiges of dnssec-signkey and
dnssec-makekeyset (removed from Makefile years ago).

1851.

Doxygen comment markup. [RT #11398]

1850.

Memory leak in lwres_getipnodebyaddr(). [RT #14591]

1849.

All forms of the man pages (docbook, man, html) should
have consistent copyright dates.

1848.

Improve SMF integration. [RT #13238]

1847.

isc_ondestroy_init() is called too late in
dns_rbtdb_create()/dns_rbtdb64_create().
[RT #13661]

1846.

query-loc-0.3.0 from Stephane Bortzmeyer

<bortzmeyer@nic.fr>.
1845.

Improve error reporting to distinguish between
accept()/fcntl() and socket()/fcntl() errors.
[RT #13745]

1844.

inet_pton() accepted more that 4 hexadecimal digits
for each 16 bit piece of the IPv6 address. The text
representation of a IPv6 address has been tightened
to disallow this (draft-ietf-ipv6-addr-arch-v4-02.txt).
[RT #5662]

1843.

CINCLUDES takes precedence over CFLAGS. This helps
when CFLAGS contains "-I /usr/local/include"
resulting in old header files being used.

1842.

cmsg_len() could produce incorrect results on
some platform. [RT #13744]

1841.

"dig +nssearch" now makes a recursive query to
find the list of nameservers to query. [RT #13694]

1840.

dnssec-signzone can now randomize signature end times
(dnssec-signzone -j jitter). [RT #13609]

1839.

<isc/hash.h> was not being installed.

1838.

Don't allow Linux capabilities to be inherited.
[RT #13707]

1837.

Compile time option ISC_FACILITY was not effective
for 'named -u <user>'. [RT #13714]

1836.

Silence compiler warnings in hash_test.c.

1835.

Update dnssec-signzone's usage message. [RT #13657]

1834.

Bad memset in rdata_test.c. [RT #13658]

1833.

Race condition in isc_mutex_lock_profile(). [RT #13660]

1832.

named fails to return BADKEY on unknown TSIG algorithm.

1831.

Update named-checkzone documentation. [RT #13604]

adb lame cache has sense of test reversed. [RT #13600]

win32: "pid-file none;" broken. [RT #13563]

isc_rwlock_init() failed to properly cleanup if it

host: update usage message for '-a'. [RT #37116]

Missing DESTROYLOCK() in isc_mem_createx() on out
of memory error. [RT #13537]

1825.

Missing UNLOCK() on out of memory error from in
rbtdb.c:subtractrdataset(). [RT #13519]

1824.

Memory leak on dns_zone_setdbtype() failure.

1823.

Wrong macro used to check for point to point interface.
[RT #13418]

1822.

check-names test for RT was reversed. [RT #13382]

1821.

1820.

Gracefully handle acl loops. [RT #13659]

1819.

The validator needed to check both the algorithm and
digest types of the DS to determine if it could be
used to introduce a secure zone. [RT #13593]

1818.

'named-checkconf -z' triggered an INSIST. [RT #13599]

1817.

Add support for additional zone file formats for
improving loading performance. The masterfile-format
option in named.conf can be used to specify a
non-default format. A separate command
named-compilezone was provided to generate zone files
in the new format. Additionally, the -I and -O options
for dnssec-signzone specify the input and output
formats.

1816.

UnixWare: failed to compile lib/isc/unix/net.c.
[RT #13597]

1815.

nsupdate triggered a REQUIRE if the server was set
without also setting the zone and it encountered
a CNAME and was using TSIG. [RT #13086]

1814.

UNIX domain controls are now supported.

1813.

Restructured the data locking framework using
architecture dependent atomic operations (when
available), improving response performance on
multi-processor machines significantly.
x86, x86_64, alpha, powerpc, and mips are currently
supported.

1812.

win32: IN6_IS_ADDR_UNSPECIFIED macro is incorrect.
[RT #13453]

1811.

Preserve the case of domain names in rdata during
zone transfers. [RT #13547]

1810.

configure, lib/bind/configure make different default
decisions about whether to do a threaded build.
[RT #13212]

1809.

"make distclean" failed for libbind if the platform
is not supported.

1808.

zone.c:notify_zone() contained a race condition,
zone->db could change underneath it. [RT #13511]

1807.

When forwarding (forward only) set the active domain
from the forward zone name. [RT #13526]

1806.

The resolver returned the wrong result when a CNAME /
DNAME was encountered when fetching glue from a
secure namespace. [RT #13501]

1805.

Pending status was not being cleared when DLV was
active. [RT #13501]

1804.

Ensure that if we are queried for glue that it fits
in the additional section or TC is set to tell the
client to retry using TCP. [RT #10114]

1803.

dnssec-signzone sometimes failed to remove old
RRSIGs. [RT #13483]

1802.

Handle connection resets better. [RT #11280]

1801.

Report differences between hints and real NS rrset
and associated address records.

1800.

Changes #1719 allowed a INSIST to be triggered.
[RT #13428]

1799.

'rndc flushname' failed to flush negative cache
entries. [RT #13438]

1798.

The server syntax has been extended to support a
range of servers. [RT #11132]

1797.

named-checkconf now check acls to verify that they
only refer to existing acls. [RT #13101]

1796.

"rndc freeze/thaw" now freezes/thaws all zones.

1795.

"rndc dumpdb" was not fully documented. Minor
formatting issues with "rndc dumpdb -all". [RT #13396]

1794.

Named and named-checkzone can now both check for
non-terminal wildcard records.

1793.

Extend adjusting TTL warning messages. [RT #13378]

New zone option "notify-delay". Specify a minimum
delay between sets of NOTIFY messages.

'host -t a' still printed out AAAA and MX records.
[RT #13230]

1790.

Move lib/dns/sec/dst up into lib/dns.
allow parallel make to succeed.

Prerequisite test for tkey and dnssec could fail
with "configure --with-libtool".

1788.

libbind9.la/libbind9.so needs to link against
libisccfg.la/libisccfg.so.

1787.

HPUX: both "cc" and "gcc" need -Wl,+vnocompatwarnings.

1786.

AIX: libt_api needs to be taught to look for
T_testlist in the main executable (--with-libtool).
[RT #13239]

1785.

libbind9.la/libbind9.so needs to link against
libisc.la/libisc.so.

1784.

"libtool -allow-undefined" is the default.
Leave hooks in configure to allow it to be set
if needed in the future.

1783.

We only need one copy of libtool.m4, ltmain.sh in the
source tree.

1782.

OSX: --with-libtool + --enable-libbind broke on
__evOptMonoTime. [RT #13219]

1781.

FreeBSD 5.3: set PTHREAD_SCOPE_SYSTEM. [RT #12810]

1780.

Update libtool to 1.5.10.

1779.

OSF 5.1: libtool didn't handle -pthread correctly.

HUX 11.11: fix broken IN6ADDR_ANY_INIT and

1777.

OSF 5.1: fix broken IN6ADDR_ANY_INIT and

This should

IN6ADDR_LOOPBACK_INIT macros.
1776.

Solaris 2.9: fix broken IN6ADDR_ANY_INIT and
IN6ADDR_LOOPBACK_INIT macros.

1775.

Only compile getnetent_r.c when threaded. [RT #13205]

1774.

Aix: Silence compiler warnings / build failures.
[RT #13154]

1773.

Fast retry on host / net unreachable. [RT #13153]

1772.

1771.

1770.

named-checkconf failed to report missing a missing
file clause for rbt{64} master/hint zones. [RT #13009]

1769.

win32: change compiler flags /MTd ==> /MDd,
/MT ==> /MD.

1768.

nsecnoexistnodata() could be called with a non-NSEC
rdataset. [RT #12907]

Builds on IPv6 platforms without IPv6 Advanced API
support for (struct in6_pktinfo) failed. [RT #13077]

Update the master file timestamp on successful refresh
as well as the journal's timestamp. [RT #13062]

configure --with-openssl=auto failed. [RT #12937]

dns_zone_replacedb failed to emit a error message
if there was no SOA record in the replacement db.

1763.

Perform sanity checks on NS records which refer to
'in zone' names. [RT #13002]

1762.

isc_interfaceiter_create() could return ISC_R_SUCCESS
even when it failed. [RT #12995]

'rndc dumpdb' didn't report unassociated entries.

Host / net unreachable was not penalising rtt

Named failed to startup if the OS supported IPv6

Don't send notify messages to self. [RT #12933]

host now can turn on memory debugging flags with '-m'.

named-checkconf now checks the logging configuration.

allow-update is now settable at the options / view

We weren't always attempting to query the parent

Don't serve a slave zone which has no NS records.

Move isc_app_start() to after ns_os_daemonise()

--enable-getifaddrs failed under linux. [RT #12867]

lib/bind/make/rules.in:subdirs was not bash friendly.

'check-names response ignore;' failed to ignore.

dig now returns the byte count for axfr/ixfr.

BIND 8 compatibility: named/named-checkconf failed

Make public the function to read a key file,

darwin: relax version test in ifconfig.sh.

Determine the length type used by the socket API.

Update check-names documentation.

Look for DNSKEY records with "dig +sigtrace".

Silence compiler warnings from t_tasks.c. [RT #12493]

Don't commit the journal on malformed ixfr streams.

Error message from the journal processing were not

'dig +chase' did not terminate on a RFC 2308 Type 1

named.conf(5) was being installed in the wrong

Missing FULLCHECK for "trusted-key" in dig.

sdb/ldap updated to version 1.0-beta.

lwres needed a snprintf() implementation for

named would loop sending NOTIFY messages when it

also-notify should not be applied to built in zones.

A minimal named.conf man page.

dnssec-signzone can generate "not exact" errors

1698.

Use reserved IPv6 documentation prefix.

dnssec-signzone failed to clean out nodes that

alt-transfer-source and alt-transfer-source-v6.
SECURITY: use-alt-transfer-source is ENABLED unless
you are using views. This may cause a security risk
resulting in accidental disclosure of wrong zone
content if the master supplying different source
content based on IP address. If you are not certain
ISC recommends setting use-alt-transfer-source no;

Log file name when unable to open memory statistics

remove IFF_RUNNING test when scanning interfaces.

log the reason for rejecting a server when resolving

Support patches OpenSSL libraries.

nsupdate was extremely wasteful of memory.

lwres man pages had illegal nroff.

sdb/ldap to version 0.9.

Minimum OpenSSL version now 0.9.6e (was 0.9.5a).

1347.

1346.

Use a explicit -Wformat with gcc.

Log if the serial number on the master has gone

Log successful notifies received (info).

Log remote address with TCP dispatch failures.

Allow a rate limiter to be stalled.

Delay and spread out the startup refresh load.

1337.

When performing a nonexistence proof, the validator

When signing/verifying rdatasets, duplicate rdatas

Report the current serial with periodic commits when

Adjust log

Generate DNSSEC wildcard proofs.

When processing events (non-threaded) only allow

The validator could incorrectly verify an invalid

The validator would incorrectly mark data as insecure

DNAME/CNAME signatures were not being cached when

If the tcpquota was exhausted it was possible to

query-source-v6 was missing from options section.

lwres_getrrsetbyname leaked memory.

When verifying that an NXT proves nonexistence, check

preferred-glue option from BIND 8.3.

The dnssec system test failed to remove the correct

nslint-2.1a3 (from author).

Multi-threaded servers could deadlock in ferror()
when reloading zone files. [RT #1951, #1998]

1133.

IN6_IS_ADDR_LOOPBACK was not portably defined on
platforms without IN6_IS_ADDR_LOOPBACK. [RT #2106]

1132.

Improve UPDATE prerequisite failure diagnostic messages.

1131.

The match-destinations view option did not work with
IPv6 destinations. [RT #2073, #2074]

1130.

Log messages reporting an out-of-range serial number
did not include the out-of-range number but the
following token. [RT #2076]

1129.

Multi-threaded servers could crash under heavy
resolution load due to a race condition. [RT #2018]

1128.

sdb drivers can now provide RR data in either text
or wire format, the latter using the new functions
dns_sdb_putrdata() and dns_sdb_putnamedrdata().

1127.

rndc: If the server to contact has multiple addresses,
try all of them.

1126.

The server could access a freed event if shut
down while a client start event was pending
delivery. [RT #2061]

1125.

rndc: -k option was missing from usage message.
[RT #2057]

1124.

dig: +[no]dnssec, +[no]besteffort and +[no]fail
are now documented. [RT #2052]

1123.

dig +[no]fail did not match description. [RT #2052]

1122.

Resolution timeout reduced from 90 to 30 seconds.
[RT #2046]

1121.

The server could attempt to access a NULL zone
table if shut down while resolving.

[RT #1587, #2054]
1120.

Errors in options were not fatal. [RT #2002]

1119.

Added support in Win32 for NTFS file/directory ACL's
for access control.

1118.

On multi-threaded servers, a race condition
could cause an assertion failure in resolver.c
during resolver shutdown. [RT #2029]

1117.

The configure check for in6addr_loopback incorrectly
succeeded on AIX 4.3 when compiling with -O2
because the test code was optimized away.
[RT #2016]

1116.

Setting transfers in a server clause, transfers-in,
or transfers-per-ns to a value greater than
2147483647 disabled transfers. [RT #2002]

1115.

Set maximum values for cleaning-interval,
heartbeat-interval, interface-interval,
max-transfer-idle-in, max-transfer-idle-out,
max-transfer-time-in, max-transfer-time-out,
statistics-interval of 28 days and
sig-validity-interval of 3660 days. [RT #2002]

1114.

Ignore more accept() errors. [RT #2021]

1113.

The allow-update-forwarding option was ignored
when specified in a view. [RT #2014]

1112.

1111.

Multi-threaded servers could deadlock processing
recursive queries due to a locking hierarchy
violation in adb.c. [RT #2017]

1110.

dig should only accept valid abbreviations of +options.
[RT #2003]

1109.

nsupdate accepted illegal ttl values.

1108.

On Win32, rndc was hanging when named was not running
due to failure to select for exceptional conditions
in select(). [RT #1870]

1107.

nsupdate could catch an assertion failure if an
invalid domain name was given as the argument to
the "zone" command.

1106.

After seeing an out of range TTL, nsupdate would

treat all TTLs as out of range. [RT #2001]
1105.

OpenUNIX 8 enable threads by default. [RT #1970]

1104.

Invalid arguments to the transfer-format option
could cause an assertion failure. [RT #1995]

1103.

OpenUNIX 8 support (ifconfig.sh). [RT #1970]

1102.

Note that query logging is enabled by directing the
queries category to a channel.

1101.

Array bounds read error in lwres_gai_strerror.

1100.

libbind: DNSSEC key ids were computed incorrectly.

1099.

libbind: defining REPORT_ERRORS in lib/bind/dst caused
compile time errors.

1098.

libbind: HMAC-MD5 key files are now mode 0600.

1097.

libbind: RES_PRF_TRUNC for dig.

1096.

libbind: "DNSSEC OK" (DO) support.

1095.

libbind: resolver option: no-tld-query. disables
trying unqualified as a tld. no_tld_query is also
supported for FreeBSD compatibility.

1094.

libbind: add support gcc's format string checking.

1093.

libbind: miscellaneous nroff fixes.

1092.

libbind: get*by*() failed to check if res_init() had
been called.

1091.

libbind: misplaced va_end().

1090.

libbind: dns_ho.c:add_hostent() was not returning
the amount of memory consumed resulting in garbage
address being returned. Alignment calculations were
wasting space. We weren't suppressing duplicate
addresses.

1089.

libbind: inet_{cidr,net}_{pton,ntop}() now have IPv6
support.

1088.

libbind: MPE/iX C.70 (incomplete)

1087.

libbind: struct __res_state too large on 64 bit arch.

1086.

libbind: sunos: old sprintf.

1085.

libbind: solaris: sys_nerr and sys_errlist do not
exist when compiling in 64 bit mode.

1084.

libbind: gai_strerror() rewritten.

1083.

The default control channel listened on the
wildcard address, not the loopback as documented.
[RT #1975]

1082.

The -g option to named incorrectly caused logging
to be sent to syslog in addition to stderr.
[RT #1974]

1081.

Multicast queries were incorrectly identified
based on the source address, not the destination
address.

1080.

BIND 8 compatibility: accept bare IP prefixes
as the second element of a two-element top level
sort list statement. [RT #1964]

1079.

BIND 8 compatibility: accept bare elements at top
level of sort list treating them as if they were
a single element list. [RT #1963]

1078.

We failed to correct bad tv_usec values in one case.
[RT #1966]

1077.

Do not accept further recursive clients when
the total number of recursive lookups being
processed exceeds max-recursive-clients, even
if some of the lookups are internally generated.
[RT #1915, #1938]

1076.

A badly defined global key could trigger an assertion
on load/reload if views were used. [RT #1947]

1075.

Out-of-range network prefix lengths were not
reported. [RT #1954]

1074.

Running out of memory in dump_rdataset() could
cause an assertion failure. [RT #1946]

1073.

The ADB cache cleaning should also be space driven.
[RT #1915, #1938]

1072.

The TCP client quota could be exceeded when
recursion occurred. [RT #1937]

1071.

Sockets listening for TCP DNS connections
specified an excessive listen backlog. [RT #1937]

1070.

Copy DNSSEC OK (DO) to response as specified by
draft-ietf-dnsext-dnssec-okbit-03.txt.

1069.

1068.

errno could be overwritten by catgets(). [RT #1921]

1067.

Allow quotas to be soft, isc_quota_soft().

1066.

Provide a thread safe wrapper for strerror().
[RT #1689]

1065.

Runtime support to select new / old style interface
scanning using ioctls.

1064.

Do not shut down active network interfaces if we
are unable to scan the interface list. [RT #1921]

1063.

libbind: "make install" was failing on IRIX.
[RT #1919]

1062.

If the control channel listener socket was shut
down before server exit, the listener object could
be freed twice. [RT #1916]

1061.

If periodic cache cleaning happened to start
while cleaning due to reaching the configured
maximum cache size was in progress, the server
could catch an assertion failure. [RT #1912]

1060.

Move refresh, stub and notify UDP retry processing
into dns_request.

1059.

dns_request now support will now retry UDP queries,
dns_request_createvia2() and dns_request_createraw2().

1058.

Limited lifetime ticker timers are now available,
isc_timertype_limited.

1057.

Reloading the server after adding a "file" clause
to a zone statement could cause the server to
crash due to a typo in change 1016.

1056.

Rndc could catch an assertion failure on SIGINT due
to an uninitialized variable. [RT #1908]

1055.

Version and hostname queries can now be disabled
using "version none;" and "hostname none;",
respectively.

1054.

On Win32, cfg_categories and cfg_modules need to be

exported from the libisccfg DLL.
1053.

Dig did not increase its timeout when receiving
AXFRs unless the +time option was used. [RT #1904]

1052.

Journals were not being created in binary mode
resulting in "journal format not recognized" error
under Win32. [RT #1889]

1051.

Do not ignore a network interface completely just
because it has a noncontiguous netmask. Instead,
omit it from the localnets ACL and issue a warning.
[RT #1891]

1050.

Log messages reporting malformed IP addresses in
address lists such as that of the forwarders option
failed to include the correct error code, file
name, and line number. [RT #1890]

1049.

"pid-file none;" will disable writing a pid file.
[RT #1848]

1048.

Servers built with -DISC_MEM_USE_INTERNAL_MALLOC=1
didn't work.

1047.

named was incorrectly refusing all requests signed
with a TSIG key derived from an unsigned TKEY
negotiation with a NOERROR response. [RT #1886]

1046.

The help message for the --with-openssl configure
option was inaccurate. [RT #1880]

1045.

It was possible to skip saving glue for a nameserver
for a stub zone.

1044.

Specifying allow-transfer, notify-source, or
notify-source-v6 in a stub zone was not treated
as an error.

1043.

Specifying a transfer-source or transfer-source-v6
option in the zone statement for a master zone was
not treated as an error. [RT #1876]

1042.

The "config" logging category did not work properly.
[RT #1873]

1041.

Dig/host/nslookup could catch an assertion failure
on SIGINT due to an uninitialized variable. [RT #1867]

1040.

Multiple listen-on-v6 options with different ports
were not accepted. [RT #1875]

1039.

Negative responses with CNAMEs in the answer section
were cached incorrectly. [RT #1862]

1038.

In servers configured with a tkey-domain option,
TKEY queries with an owner name other than the root
could cause an assertion failure. [RT #1866, #1869]

1037.

Negative responses whose authority section contain
SOA or NS records whose owner names are not equal
equal to or parents of the query name should be
rejected. [RT #1862]

1036.

Silently drop requests received via multicast as
long as there is no final multicast DNS standard.

1035.

If we respond to multicast queries (which we
currently do not), respond from a unicast address
as specified in RFC 1123. [RT #137]

1034.

Ignore the RD bit on multicast queries as specified
in RFC 1123. [RT #137]

1033.

Always respond to requests with an unsupported opcode
with NOTIMP, even if we don't have a matching view
or cannot determine the class.

1032.

hostname.bind/txt/chaos now returns the name of
the machine hosting the nameserver. This is useful
in diagnosing problems with anycast servers.

1031.

libbind.a: isc__gettimeofday() infinite recursion.
[RT #1858]

1030.

On systems with no resolv.conf file, nsupdate
exited with an error rather than defaulting
to using the loopback address. [RT #1836]

1029.

Some named.conf errors did not cause the loading
of the configuration file to return a failure
status even though they were logged. [RT #1847]

1028.

On Win32, dig/host/nslookup looked for resolv.conf
in the wrong directory. [RT #1833]

1027.

RRs having the reserved type 0 should be rejected.
[RT #1471]

1026.

1025.

Don't use multicast addresses to resolve iterative
queries. [RT #101]

1024.

Compilation failed on HP-UX 11.11 due to
incompatible use of the SIOCGLIFCONF macro
name. [RT #1831]

1023.

Accept hints without TTLs.

1022.

Don't report empty root hints as "extra data".
[RT #1802]

1021.

On Win32, log message timestamps were one month
later than they should have been, and the server
would exhibit unspecified behavior in December.

1020.

IXFR log messages did not distinguish between
true IXFRs, AXFR-style IXFRs, and mere version
polls. [RT #1811]

1019.

The value of the lame-ttl option was limited to 18000
seconds, not 1800 seconds as documented. [RT #1803]

1018.

The default log channel was not always initialized
correctly. [RT #1813]

1017.

When specifying TSIG keys to dig and nsupdate using
the -k option, they must be HMAC-MD5 keys. [RT #1810]

1016.

Slave zones with no backup file were re-transferred
on every server reload.

1015.

Log channels that had a "versions" option but no
"size" option failed to create numbered log
files. [RT #1783]

1014.

Some queries would cause statistics counters to
increment more than once or not at all. [RT #1321]

1013.

It was possible to cancel a query twice when marking
a server as bogus or by having a blackhole acl.
[RT #1776]

1012.

The -p option to named did not behave as documented.

1011.

Removed isc_dir_current().

1010.

The server could attempt to execute a command channel
command after initiating server shutdown, causing
an assertion failure. [RT #1766]

1009.

OpenUNIX 8 support. [RT #1728]

1008.

libtool.m4, ltmain.sh from libtool-1.4.2.

1007.

config.guess, config.sub from autoconf-2.52.

1006.

If a KEY RR was found missing during DNSSEC validation,
an assertion failure could subsequently be triggered
in the resolver. [RT #1763]

1005.

Don't copy nonzero RCODEs from request to response.
[RT #1765]

1004.

Deal with recvfrom() returning EHOSTDOWN. [RT #1770]

1003.

Add the +retry option to dig.

1002.

When reporting an unknown class name in named.conf,
including the file name and line number. [RT #1759]

1001.

win32 socket code doio_recv was not catching a
WSACONNRESET error when a client was timing out
the request and closing its socket. [RT #1745]

1000.

BIND 8 compatibility: accept "HESIOD" as an alias
for class "HS". [RT #1759]

999.

"rndc retransfer zone [class [view]]" added.
[RT #1752]

998.

named-checkzone now has arguments to specify the
chroot directory (-t) and working directory (-w).
[RT #1755]

997.

Add support for RSA-SHA1 keys (RFC3110).

996.

Issue warning if the configuration filename contains
the chroot path.

995.

dig, host, nslookup: using a raw IPv6 address as a
target address should be fatal on a IPv4 only system.

994.

Treat non-authoritative responses to queries for type
NS as referrals even if the NS records are in the
answer section, because BIND 8 servers incorrectly
send them that way. This is necessary for DNSSEC
validation of the NS records of a secure zone to
succeed when the parent is a BIND 8 server. [RT #1706]

993.

dig: -v now reports the version.

992.

dig: ~/.digrc is now documented.

991.

Lower UDP refresh timeout messages to level
debug 1.

990.

The rndc-confgen man page was not installed.

989.

Report filename if $INCLUDE fails for file related
errors. [RT #1736]

988.

'additional-from-auth no;' did not work reliably
in the case of queries answered from the cache.
[RT #1436]

987.

"dig -help" didn't show "+[no]stats".

986.

"dig +noall" failed to clear stats and command
printing.

985.

Consider network interfaces to be up iff they have
a nonzero IP address rather than based on the
IFF_UP flag. [RT #1160]

984.

Multi-threading should be enabled by default on
Solaris 2.7 and newer, but it wasn't.

983.

The server now supports generating IXFR difference
sequences for non-dynamic zones by comparing zone
versions, when enabled using the new config
option "ixfr-from-differences". [RT #1727]

982.

If "memstatistics-file" is set in options the memory
statistics will be written to it.

981.

The dnssec tools can now take multiple '-r randomfile'
arguments.

980.

Incoming zone transfers restarting after an error
could trigger an assertion failure. [RT #1692]

979.

Incremental master file dumping. dns_master_dumpinc(),
dns_master_dumptostreaminc(), dns_dumpctx_attach(),
dns_dumpctx_detach(), dns_dumpctx_cancel(),
dns_dumpctx_db() and dns_dumpctx_version().

978.

dns_db_attachversion() had an invalid REQUIRE()
condition.

977.

Improve "not at top of zone" error message.

976.

named-checkconf can now test load master zones
(named-checkconf -z). [RT #1468]

975.

"max-cache-size default;" as a view option
caused an assertion failure.

974.

"max-cache-size unlimited;" as a global option

was not accepted.
973.

Failed to log the question name when logging:
"bad zone transfer request: non-authoritative zone
(NOTAUTH)".

972.

The file modification time code in zone.c was using the
wrong epoch. [RT #1667]

971.

970.

'max-journal-size' can now be used to set a target
size for a journal.

969.

dig now supports the undocumented dig 8 feature
of allowing arbitrary labels, not just dotted
decimal quads, with the -x option. This can be
used to conveniently look up RFC2317 names as in
"dig -x 10.0.0.0-127". [RT #827, #1576, #1598]

968.

On win32, the isc_time_now() function was unnecessarily
calling strtime(). [RT #1671]

967.

On win32, the link for bindevt was not including the
required resource file to enable the event viewer
to interpret the error messages in the event log,
[RT #1668]

966.

965.

Including data other than root server NS and A
records in the root hint file could cause a rbtdb
node reference leak. [RT #1581, #1618]

964.

Warn if data other than root server NS and A records
are found in the root hint file. [RT #1581, #1618]

963.

Bad ISC_LANG_ENDDECLS. [RT #1645]

962.

libbind: bad "#undef", don't attempt to install
non-existent nlist.h. [RT #1640]

961.

Tried to use a IPV6 feature when ISC_PLATFORM_HAVEIPV6
was not defined. [RT #1482]

960.

liblwres failed to build on systems with support for
getrrsetbyname() in the OS. [RT #1592]

959.

On FreeBSD, determine the number of CPUs by calling
sysctlbyname(). [RT #1584]

958.

ssize_t is not available on all platforms. [RT #1607]

957.

sys/select.h inclusion was broken on older platforms.
[RT #1607]

956.

ns_g_autorndcfile changed to ns_g_keyfile
in named/win32/os.c due to code changes in
change #953. win32 .make file for rndc-confgen
updated to add include path for os.h header.

--- 9.2.0rc1 released --955.

When using views, the zone's class was not being
inherited from the view's class. [RT #1583]

954.

When requesting AXFRs or IXFRs using dig, host, or
nslookup, the RD bit should not be set as zone
transfers are inherently non-recursive. [RT #1575]

953.

The /var/run/named.key file from change #843
has been replaced by /etc/rndc.key. Both
named and rndc will look for this file and use
it to configure a default control channel key
if not already configured using a different
method (rndc.conf / controls). Unlike
named.key, rndc.key is not created automatically;
it must be created by manually running
"rndc-confgen -a".

952.

The server required manual intervention to serve the
affected zones if it died between creating a journal
and committing the first change to it.

951.

CFLAGS was not passed to the linker when
linking some of the test programs under
bin/tests. [RT #1555].

950.

Explicit TTLs did not properly override $TTL
due to a bug in change 834. [RT #1558]

949.

host was unable to print records larger than 512
bytes. [RT #1557]

--- 9.2.0b2 released --948.

Integrated support for building on Windows NT /
Windows 2000.

947.

dns_rdata_soa_t had a badly named element "mname" which
was really the RNAME field from RFC1035. To avoid
confusion and silent errors that would occur it the
"origin" and "mname" elements were given their correct

names "mname" and "rname" respectively, the "mname"
element is renamed to "contact".
946.

doc/misc/options is now machine-generated from the
configuration parser syntax tables, and therefore
more likely to be correct.

945.

Add the new view-specific options
"match-destinations" and "match-recursive-only".

944.

Check for expired signatures on load.

943.

The server could crash when receiving a command
via rndc if the configuration file listed only
nonexistent keys in the controls statement. [RT #1530]

942.

libbind: GETNETBYADDR_ADDR_T was not correctly
defined on some platforms.

941.

The configuration checker crashed if a slave
zone didn't contain a masters statement. [RT #1514]

940.

Double zone locking failure on error path. [RT #1510]

--- 9.2.0b1 released --939.

Add the --disable-linux-caps option to configure for
systems that manage capabilities outside of named.
[RT #1503]

938.

937.

A race when shutting down a zone could trigger a
INSIST() failure. [RT #1034]

936.

Warn about IPv4 addresses that are not complete
dotted quads. [RT #1084]

935.

inet_pton failed to reject leading zeros.

934.

Deal with systems where accept() spuriously returns
ECONNRESET.

933.

configure failed doing libbind on platforms not
supported by BIND 8. [RT #1496]

--- 9.2.0a3 released --932.

Use INSTALL_SCRIPT, not INSTALL_PROGRAM,
when installing isc-config.sh.
[RT #198, #1466]

931.

The controls statement only attempted to verify
messages using the first key in the key list.
(9.2.0a1/a2 only).

930.

Query performance testing tool added as
contrib/queryperf.

929.

928.

nsupdate would send empty update packets if the
send (or empty line) command was run after
another send but before any new updates or
prerequisites were specified. It should simply
ignore this command.

927.

Don't hold the zone lock for the entire dump to disk.
[RT #1423]

926.

The resolver could deadlock with the ADB when
shutting down (multi-threaded builds only).
[RT #1324]

925.

Remove openssl from the distribution; require that
--with-openssl be specified if DNSSEC is needed.

924.

Extend support for pre-RFC2133 IPv6 implementation.
[RT #987]

923.

Multiline TSIG secrets (and other multiline strings)
were not accepted in named.conf. [RT #1469]

922.

Added two new lwres_getrrsetbyname() result codes,
ERR_NONAME and ERR_NODATA.

921.

lwres returned an incorrect error code if it received
a truncated message.

920.

Increase the lwres receive buffer size to 16K.
[RT #1451]

919.

918.

In nsupdate, TSIG errors are no longer treated as
fatal errors.

917.

New nsupdate command 'key', allowing TSIG keys to
be specified in the nsupdate command stream rather
than the command line.

916.

Specifying type ixfr to dig without specifying
a serial number failed in unexpected ways.

915.

The named-checkconf and named-checkzone programs
now have a '-v' option for printing their version.
[RT #1151]

914.

Global 'server' statements were rejected when
using views, even though they were accepted
in 9.1. [RT #1368]

913.

Cache cleaning was not sufficiently aggressive.
[RT #1441, #1444]

912.

Attempts to set the 'additional-from-cache' or
'additional-from-auth' option to 'no' in a
server with recursion enabled will now
be ignored and cause a warning message.
[RT #1145]

911.

910.

909.

908.

New program, rndc-confgen, to simplify setting up rndc.

907.

The ability to get entropy from either the
random device, a user-provided file or from
the keyboard was migrated from the DNSSEC tools
to libisc as isc_entropy_usebestsource().

906.

Separated the system independent portion of
lib/isc/unix/entropy.c into lib/isc/entropy.c
and added lib/isc/win32/entropy.c.

905.

Configuring a forward "zone" for the root domain
did not work. [RT #1418]

904.

The server would leak memory if attempting to use
an expired TSIG key. [RT #1406]

903.

dig should not crash when receiving a TCP packet
of length 0.

902.

The -d option was ignored if both -t and -g were also
specified.

901.

900.

Some pre-RFC2133 IPv6 implementations do not define
IN6ADDR_ANY_INIT. [RT #1416]

A config.guess update changed the system identification
string of FreeBSD systems; configure and

bin/tests/system/ifconfig.sh now recognize the new
string.
--- 9.2.0a2 released --899.

lib/dns/soa.c failed to compile on many platforms
due to inappropriate use of a void value.
[RT #1372, #1373, #1386, #1387, #1395]

898.

"dig" failed to set a nonzero exit status
on UDP query timeout. [RT #1323]

897.

A config.guess update changed the system identification
string of UnixWare systems; configure now recognizes
the new string.

896.

If a configuration file is set on named's command line
and it has a relative pathname, the current directory
(after any possible jailing resulting from named -t)
will be prepended to it so that reloading works
properly even when a directory option is present.

895.

New function, isc_dir_current(), akin to POSIX's
getcwd().

894.

When using the DNSSEC tools, a message intended to warn
when the keyboard was being used because of the lack
of a suitable random device was not being printed.

893.

Removed isc_file_test() and added isc_file_exists()
for the basic functionality that was being added
with isc_file_test().

892.

891.

Return an error when a SIG(0) signed response to
an unsigned query is seen. This should actually
do the verification, but it's not currently
possible. [RT #1391]

890.

The man pages no longer require the mandoc macros
and should now format cleanly using most versions of
nroff, and HTML versions of the man pages have been
added. Both are generated from DocBook source.

889.

Eliminated blank lines before .TH in nroff man
pages since they cause problems with some versions
of nroff. [RT #1390]

888.

Don't die when using TKEY to delete a nonexistent
TSIG key. [RT #1392]

887.

Detect broken compilers that can't call static
functions from inline functions. [RT #1212]
